No Spellbook
You have no Isekai spellbook to advance, so these levels advance none. This is what an archetype whose spellbook is switched off in the mod settings takes.
Martial God Ascendant
The martial path carried past the mortal ceiling. Your discipline keeps its shape: no borrowed secret, no loophole, only the technique you have been sharpening for twenty levels.
Hero Ascendant
The hero's path carried past the mortal ceiling. What saves the world from here is still the thing that saved it before, and it is still not a cheat.
Overlord Ascendant
The overlord's path carried past the mortal ceiling. The guild master's arsenal was always complete; these levels only widen the throne room.
Slime Ascendant
The devourer's path carried past the mortal ceiling. Everything you become from here you still have to eat first.
Shadow Monarch Ascendant
The monarch's path carried past the mortal ceiling. The army grows; the bargain that raised it does not change.
God Emperor Ascendant

The imperial path carried past the mortal ceiling. Divinity is still not a grab bag of tricks: you give up the Special Power pick at ascension levels 5 and 15, because you are simply more of what you already are.
Mastermind Ascendant
The strategist's path carried past the mortal ceiling. You never won by collecting feats, so you give up the bonus feat at ascension levels 10 and 20.
Isekai Ascendant

Twenty levels into a borrowed world, the protagonist stops being its guest. An Isekai Ascendant continues the same story past the mortal ceiling: the same cheat powers, the same plot armor, the same spellbook, carried into the range where the Worldwound's own legends stop counting. It is not a new career but the second half of one, and it begins only where the Isekai Protagonist ends.

Because the spellbook is the one you already have, it is charted under Isekai Protagonist rather than here: this page shows no spellbook row of its own. Your caster level, slots and spells known all continue to rise, and the spell pages show them correctly.
The second half of the Isekai Protagonist's path, from character level 21 to 40. It advances the spellbook you already have rather than granting a new one.

Past the twentieth level the protagonist's story stops borrowing the world's rules and starts writing them. The powers keep arriving on the same cadence they always did, and the spellbook you already carry keeps growing with them.
Isekai Protagonist

LocalizedStrings.enGB: At 7th level, your defensive instincts reach perfection. You gain +10 spell resistance and a +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class.
Absolute Counter

Channeling the ultimate defensive technique from another realm, you create an impenetrable barrier around yourself for 1 round. 
Benefit: As a swift action, grant yourself DR 100/-, resistance 100 to every energy damage type, including alignment and divine energy, and +20 shield AC for 1 round. Usable 2 times per day when you gain it at level 10, 3 at level 15 and 4 at level 20.
Overpowered Ability - Absolute Defense

For 1 round, you are invulnerable to mortal harm. Grants DR 100/-, resistance 100 to every energy type including alignment and divine energy, and a +20 shield bonus to Armor Class. The damage reduction does not stack with other damage reduction.
Absolute Defense

Like the Legendary Shield Hero, your defenses cannot be breached by conventional attacks. 
Benefit: Gain the swift-action Absolute Defense ability, granting DR 100/-, resistance 100 to every energy type, and +20 shield AC for 1 round.
At 5th level, replace Transcendent Domain with an aura cloaking all allies in shadows for total concealment and extra weapon attacks.
Absolute Shadow Domain
Allies and shadows gain total concealment and an additional attack.
This creature's defenses have been torn open by predatory marksmanship, suffering a -2 penalty to Armor Class.

Exhale a 30 ft cone of pure Abyssal hellfire, once per day. Deals 1d6 unholy damage per 2 character levels. Reflex save halves (DC 10 + 1/2 character level (at most +9) + Charisma modifier).

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Your otherworldly armor and skin dynamically adapt to incoming trauma. Each stack grants damage reduction 3/- and 5 energy resistance against acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic (stacking up to 5 times for DR 15/- and 25 energy resistance).
Adaptive Armor Adaptation

Your otherworldly armor and skin possess reactive evolutionary memory, hardening against hostile damage frequencies.
Benefit: Whenever you take damage from an attack or hostile effect, you gain a stacking layer of Adaptive Armor lasting 1 minute. Each stack grants damage reduction 3/- and 5 resistance against all energy types (acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic). This effect stacks up to 5 times for a maximum of DR 15/- and 25 energy resistance. Damage reduction and energy resistance from different sources do not stack with each other; only the largest of each applies.
Requires character level 5.

Once per day, you release a stroke of holy energy that deals {g|Encyclopedia:Dice}1d6{/g} points of holy {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} per 2 character levels (at least 1 die, at most 20). The target needs to make a successful Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 character level (at most +9) + Charisma modifier), or become prone.
If the target is evil, the dice are d8s instead, and a failed save also gives a -2 {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g} to {g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack rolls{/g} and saving throws.
If the target is an evil outsider or an undead creature, the dice are d10s, and a failed save gives a -4 penalty to AC, attack rolls and saving throws.
If the target is a demon lord, an evil dragon or a lord of undead (a powerful undead creature like liches, undead dragons, nightshades and similar), the dice are d12s and the target suffers a -4 penalty to AC, attack rolls and saving throws. It also needs to make a successful Reflex saving throw, or become prone.

LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Ваше иное происхождение позволяет вам легко улавливать некоторые возможности, доступные в рамках законов магии. Это позволяет вам формировать магию вокруг себя определенными способами, которые могут быть похожи на заклинания, но не совсем являются заклинаниями.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Dein außerweltlicher Hintergrund ermöglicht es dir, einige der Auswirkungen zu erlangen, die innerhalb der Gesetze der Magie verfügbar sind. Dadurch kannst du die Magie um dich herum auf spezifische Weise formen, die ähnlich wie Zauber sein können, aber nicht ganz Zauber sind.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vos origines d'outremonde vous permettent de comprendre facilement les vides et les exceptions dans les lois régissant les arts occultes. Cela vous permet de façonner la magie autour de vous de manière particulière, similaire à des sorts mais pas tout à fait.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你的异世界背景使你能够轻松掌握魔法法则中可用的一些技巧。这使你可以以特定的方式塑造你周围的魔法，这些方式可能类似于法术，但并不完全是法术。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tu origen de otro mundo te permite comprender fácilmente algunas de las habilidades disponibles dentro de las leyes de la magia. Esto te permite moldear la magia a tu alrededor de manera específica, lo cual puede ser similar a los hechizos pero no exactamente igual.

Covenant of the Archfiend
Every spell you cast is automatically Empowered and Maximized, with no increase to its casting time or to the spell slot it is cast from. You also gain a +4 bonus to all spell save DCs.
Ninth-Circle Overload

Magic was the first thing in this world that made sense, and the Archmage never stopped studying it. Each level deepens the reservoir the spells are drawn from and sharpens how they are shaped, until at the summit every spell leaves the hand empowered and maximized at no cost at all.

Requires 10 levels of Isekai Protagonist and 12 ranks in Knowledge (Arcana), which cannot be reached before character level 12. Every level advances the Isekai spellbook you choose at 1st level. Spellfire Supremacy (1st): your damaging spells deal +2 damage per damage die, and +4 to spell penetration. Arcane Reservoir (2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th and 9th): +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma per rank, up to +5. Arcane Reserves (3rd): one extra spell slot per day at every spell level from 1st to 9th. Mastery of Shaping (5th): +2 caster level. Arcane Fire (7th): a further +4 to spell penetration and +2 to your spell save DCs. Ninth-Circle Overload (10th): every spell you cast is Empowered and Maximized for free, and your spell save DCs rise by 4. You also gain an Isekai bonus feat at every even level, an Overpowered Ability at 5th and a Special Power at 9th.
Isekai prestige class for pure spellcasters: extra spell slots, caster level, penetration and save DCs, and at 10th level every spell Empowered and Maximized for free.
The Archmage
Your damaging spells deal an additional +2 damage per damage die rolled, and your spell penetration increases by +4.
Spellfire Supremacy

LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 盔甲圣徒

Ascension
*Chittering planar harmonics resonate in your mind...*

A grotesque thing of pure planar hunger caged in ethereal ribs, which eats life energy and drains the magic of everything near it. It fights with its claws alone and grows through void milestones: the Void Carapace (spell resistance 11 + its level), Ethereal Claws and the Void Singularity.
Astral Devourer
*The hunger of the outer void pulses eagerly.*
*Ethereal ribs rattle in ravenous obedience.*
*Space folds slightly as the entity awaits your direction.*
*Deep resonance of satisfaction hums from the entity's core.*
*The ambient essence is consumed. Stillness returns.*
*Space stabilizes around the emptied battlefield.*
*A piercing planar shriek echoes as reality bends!*
*Consume... consume their magical essence!*
*The void opens its jaws!*
Planar resonance and cosmic void pulses of the Astral Devourer.
Astral Devourer Resonance
*The creature hovers silently as you wake, its soothing ethereal distortion field still shielding the camp.*
*Tethers of cosmic void unravel from the tranquil perimeter they held around your resting place.*
*The low rhythmic vibrations that lulled the campsite through the night fade into stillness.*

[Isekai Protagonist Exclusive Partner]
A grotesque entity of pure planar hunger trapped in ethereal ribs.
Consumes life energy and drains the spell essence of surrounding adversaries.

The Martial God's oath. The domain is a storm of phantom blades, and the sovereign never swings alone. Infinite Blade Symphony replaces Transcendent Domain at 5th level: orbiting phantom blades deal 6d6 force damage each round to enemies within 25 feet. Ten Thousand Blades replaces Crown of Stories at 9th level: +2d6 force damage on weapon attacks and +10 to confirm critical hits. Only a Martial God can swear it; everything else is the Transcendent Sovereign's.
Phantom Sovereign
Permanently grants a +5 bonus to damage rolls.
Astral Weapon Attunement
Allies within 30 feet of the benevolent sovereign gain a +4 sacred bonus to saving throws against fear and mind-affecting effects, and Fast Healing 3.
Aura of Righteous Majesty

You govern your domain with regal benevolence and awe-inspiring presence. You and all allies within 30 feet gain a +4 bonus to saving throws against fear and mind-affecting effects, and Fast Healing 3. Furthermore, your summoned guardians gain a +4 deflection bonus to AC and deal +1d6 extra damage.

Every time you cast a shadow spell, it becomes 20% more real, as though using the Solid Shadows Spell feat. Requires character level 5.
Overpowered Ability - Auto Solid Shadows

You have bound your soul to the supreme contract of Hell. 
Benefit: You gain a +4 profane bonus to AC, attack rolls and the DC of all your abilities, immunity to fire, and immunity to harmful mind-affecting effects (charm, compulsion, confusion, daze, fear, sleep and despair), whether they come from a spell or any other source. Helpful mind-affecting effects from allies still reach you, except compulsions such as the Rage spell.
Profane bonuses do not stack with other profane bonuses (for example the Overlord's Corrupt Aura or the Shadow Monarch's domain); only the highest applies.
Avatar of the Prince of Darkness

The untamed plunder of the oceans is yours to command. 
Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus to AC and all saving throws that stacks with everything, including your Plot Armor, a +4 luck bonus to attack rolls, a +4 bonus to combat maneuver bonus and defense, and fast healing 5.
The luck bonus to attack rolls does not stack with other luck bonuses to attack (for example Signature Attack); only the highest applies.
Avatar of the Pirate Queen

The silent dark between the stars folds around you, and blows meant for you fall into it. 
Benefit: Attacks against you have a 50% miss chance, as displacement (true seeing ignores it). You gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC, a +4 bonus to Will saves and initiative, a +4 bonus to damage rolls, and immunity to cold and sonic damage.
The miss chance does not stack with other concealment; the highest applies. Dodge bonuses stack, but are lost while you are flat-footed. The other bonuses are untyped and stack with everything.
Avatar of the Silence Between

The intoxicating vengeance of Calistria flows in your blood. 
Benefit: You gain a +4 insight bonus to initiative, attack rolls, AC and Reflex saves, +4d6 sneak attack damage, and immunity to poison, whether it comes from a spell or any other source.
Insight bonuses do not stack with other insight bonuses (for example the Aeon boon, Omniscient Mimicry or Grandmaster Transcendence); only the highest applies, and the sneak attack dice replace smaller insight sneak attack bonuses.
Avatar of the Savored Sting

You have attained the pinnacle of favor with Cayden Cailean. 
Benefit: You gain a +4 sacred bonus to attack rolls, AC and all saving throws, fast healing 5, and immunity to nausea and to fear and compulsion effects, whether they come from a spell or any other source.
Sacred bonuses do not stack with other sacred bonuses (for example the Ring of Omnipresence, the Rulebreaker Mythic Pact or the Angel boon); only the highest applies.
The compulsion immunity also refuses helpful compulsions from allies, such as the Rage spell and Blessing of Luck and Resolve, as the game's own compulsion immunity does.
Avatar of the Lucky Drunk
Allies within 30 feet gain a +4 luck bonus to all saving throws and a +3 luck bonus to attack rolls and AC.
An ally of Chaldira's avatar stands near. This character gains a +4 luck bonus to all saving throws and a +3 luck bonus to attack rolls and AC.
Chaldira's Mischievous Fortune

The boundless good fortune of Chaldira shields your comrades. 
Benefit: Your allies within 30 feet gain a +4 luck bonus to all saving throws and a +3 luck bonus to attack rolls and AC. You gain a +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws that stacks with everything.
You do not receive the aura's luck bonuses: your Plot Armor already gives you a luck bonus that would replace them. The aura's luck bonuses do not stack with other luck bonuses your allies have; only the highest applies.
Avatar of the Mischievous Friend

The starlight of Desna guides your every step. 
Benefit: You gain a +30 foot sacred bonus to speed and a +4 sacred bonus to AC and all saving throws. Whenever a saving throw roll would fail, you roll it again and keep the better result. You are immune to paralysis and entanglement, and to curses, movement-impairing effects and sleep, whether they come from a spell or any other source.
Sacred bonuses do not stack with other sacred bonuses (for example the Ring of Omnipresence or the Angel boon); only the highest applies.
Avatar of the Song of the Spheres

The insatiable thunder of war fuels your sinews. 
Benefit: You gain a +6 bonus to Strength, a +4 bonus to Constitution and a +4 bonus to damage rolls, one extra attack at your highest attack bonus when you make a full attack, damage reduction 10/- that stacks with your other damage reduction, and immunity to fatigue and exhaustion. The bonuses are untyped and stack with everything.
Avatar of Our Lord in Iron

You stand as the living standard of Iomedae's holy crusade. 
Benefit: You gain a +4 sacred bonus to AC, attack rolls and all saving throws, and a +6 sacred bonus to damage rolls.
Sacred bonuses do not stack with other sacred bonuses (for example the Ring of Omnipresence, the Rulebreaker Mythic Pact or the Angel boon); only the highest applies. This avatar overwrites Iomedae's own Vanguard of the Inheritor blessing (+3 sacred AC and saves), which adds nothing while you embody her.
Avatar of the Inheritor

The shapeshifting spark of the First World dances around your silhouette. 
Benefit: You gain a +6 dodge bonus to AC, a +6 bonus to Dexterity and a +4 bonus to Will saves. You are immune to paralysis and entanglement, and to confusion, whether it comes from a spell or any other source.
Dodge bonuses stack, but like all dodge bonuses this one is lost while you are flat-footed. The other bonuses are untyped and stack with everything.
Avatar of the Laughing King

Milani's rose blooms again wherever the oppressed rise, and it has taken root in you. 
Benefit: You gain a +4 sacred bonus to AC and all saving throws, a +2 bonus to attack rolls and a +4 bonus to damage rolls, fast healing 5, and immunity to disease and bleed, whether they come from a spell or any other source.
Sacred bonuses do not stack with other sacred bonuses (for example the Ring of Omnipresence or the Angel boon); only the highest applies. The attack and damage bonuses are untyped and stack with everything.
Avatar of the Everbloom

The dual cosmic currents of absolute destruction and preservation converge upon your intellect. 
Benefit: You gain a +3 bonus to the DC of all your abilities, a +4 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance, a +4 bonus to all saving throws, a +2 bonus to attack rolls and a +4 bonus to damage rolls. You resist 10 acid, cold, electricity, fire and sonic damage, and you see invisible creatures.
The numeric bonuses are untyped and stack with everything. Energy resistance does not stack with other resistance to the same energy; the highest applies.
Avatar of the All-Seeing Eye

The final arbiter has appointed you as her sovereign agent. 
Benefit: You are immune to death effects, whether they come from a spell or any other source, to energy drain and to negative energy damage. You gain a +4 bonus to all saving throws, a +2 bonus to attack rolls and a +6 bonus to damage rolls. These bonuses are untyped and stack with everything.
Avatar of the Lady of Graves
Gain the spells of an Azata.

Beta Tester

Believing unyieldingly in the Heart of the Cards, you have stood at the apex of tabletop tournaments and sealed ancient shadow games. Heart of the Cards: you always draw first - you roll initiative twice and take the better result. Card Duelist King

Accustomed to evaluating tactical board states dozens of moves in advance, the Chess Grandmaster anticipates enemy flanking vectors and ambush lines before they can strike. Thinking Ahead: she adds her Intelligence bonus to Initiative as an insight bonus, on top of her Dexterity. She also cannot be caught flat-footed, gains a +2 insight bonus to Armor Class, and adds Perception and Knowledge (World) to her class skills with a +4 competence bonus to both.
If the character already has the class skill, {g|Encyclopedia:Weapon_Proficiency}weapon proficiency{/g} or armor proficiency granted by the selected background from her class during character creation, then the corresponding {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} from background change to a +1 competence bonus in case of skills, a +1 enhancement bonus in case of weapon proficiency and a -1 Armor {g|Encyclopedia:Check}Check{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}Penalty{/g} reduction in case of armor proficiency.
Chess Grandmaster

Years of general education and too many all-nighters before exams left the College Student a little better at everything and impossible to put to sleep. All-Nighter: she is immune to sleep effects. She also gains a +1 bonus to all attributes and adds Knowledge (Arcana) and Knowledge (World) to her class skills.
If the character already has the class skill, {g|Encyclopedia:Weapon_Proficiency}weapon proficiency{/g} or armor proficiency granted by the selected background from her class during character creation, then the corresponding {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} from background change to a +1 competence bonus in case of skills, a +1 enhancement bonus in case of weapon proficiency and a -1 Armor {g|Encyclopedia:Check}Check{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}Penalty{/g} reduction in case of armor proficiency.
College Student

Cultivating forbidden techniques in the demonic sects of another world, the Demonic Cultivator refined her body in poison baths and spirit fire until neither could harm her. Poison-Tempered Body: she is immune to poison. She also gains fire resistance 10, a +2 competence bonus on Fortitude saves and to Combat Maneuver Bonus, adds Athletics and Mobility to the list of her class skills with a +4 competence bonus on both, and uses the higher of Strength and Dexterity for Athletics and Mobility checks.
If the character already has the class skill, {g|Encyclopedia:Weapon_Proficiency}weapon proficiency{/g} or armor proficiency granted by the selected background from her class during character creation, then the corresponding {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} from background change to a +1 competence bonus in case of skills, a +1 enhancement bonus in case of weapon proficiency and a -1 Armor {g|Encyclopedia:Check}Check{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}Penalty{/g} reduction in case of armor proficiency.
Demonic Cultivator
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 修魔者

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Years of meditation on a distant mountain opened the Enlightened Sage's inner eye; she no longer needs the outer ones to see. Third Eye: she ignores all concealment and is immune to blindness. She also adds {g|Encyclopedia:Lore_Nature}Lore (Nature){/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Lore_Religion}Lore (Religion){/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Knowledge_World}Knowledge (World){/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:Knowledge_Arcana}Knowledge (Arcana){/g}, and {g|Encyclopedia:Perception}Perception{/g} to the list of her class {g|Encyclopedia:Skills}skills{/g}, and uses the higher of {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Intelligence{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wisdom{/g} for all five of those skills.
If the character already has the class skill, {g|Encyclopedia:Weapon_Proficiency}weapon proficiency{/g} or armor proficiency granted by the selected background from her class during character creation, then the corresponding {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} from background change to a +1 competence bonus in case of skills, a +1 enhancement bonus in case of weapon proficiency and a -1 Armor {g|Encyclopedia:Check}Check{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}Penalty{/g} reduction in case of armor proficiency.
Enlightened Sage
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 启蒙贤者

LocalizedStrings.enGB:

LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 野蛮人传承 - 愤怒之球

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You recall memories of otherworldly melodies and celestial harmony. 
Through music, the universal language of emotion and resolve, you inspire allies and bend planar resonance to your will.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Вы вспоминаете потусторонние мелодии и небесную гармонию. 
Через музыку, универсальный язык эмоций и решимости, вы вдохновляете союзников и подчиняете резонанс планов своей воле.
LocalizedStrings.deDE:
Sie erinnern sich an jenseitige Melodien und himmlische Harmonie. 
Durch Musik, die universelle Sprache der Emotionen und Entschlossenheit, inspirieren Sie Verbündete und beugen die Resonanz der Ebenen Ihrem Willen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR:
Vous vous remémorez des mélodies d'un autre monde et une harmonie céleste. 
Grâce à la musique, langage universel de l'émotion et de la détermination, vous inspirez vos alliés et pliez la résonance planaire à votre volonté.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
你想起了异界的旋律与天籁之音。
通过音乐这一情感与意志的通用语言，你激励盟友并将位面共鸣屈从于你的意志。
LocalizedStrings.esES:
Recuerdas melodías de otro mundo y armonía celestial. 
A través de la música, el lenguaje universal de la emoción y la determinación, inspiras a tus aliados y doblegas la resonancia planar a tu voluntad.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Bard Legacy - Musical Prodigy
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 吟游诗人传承 - 音乐神童

LocalizedStrings.enGB: At 7th level, you are able to channel your energy to form a solid barrier to shield allies from physical and magical attacks.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: На 7 уровне вы можете направить свою энергию на создание прочного барьера, защищающего союзников от физических и магических атак.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Auf Stufe 7 kannst du deine Energie kanalisieren, um eine solide Barriere zu erschaffen, die Verbündete vor physischen und magischen Angriffen schützt.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Au niveau 7, vous êtes capable de canaliser votre énergie pour former une barrière solide protégeant vos alliés contre les attaques physiques et magiques.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 在第7级，你能够引导自己的能量形成一道坚固的屏障，保护盟友免受物理和魔法攻击。
LocalizedStrings.esES: En el nivel 7, eres capaz de canalizar tu energía para formar una barrera sólida que proteja a tus aliados de ataques físicos y mágicos.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Energy Barrier
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 能量屏障

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Three times per day as a standard action, unleash the ultimate black hole stomach of Beelzebub at a point within close range, engulfing every enemy in a 30-foot radius. Enemies with no more Hit Dice than your character level must make a Fortitude save or be swallowed whole into the void and instantly destroyed. Enemies that succeed on the save, or that are too mighty to swallow, take 20d6 unholy damage instead. This is a death effect, and creatures immune to death effects are never destroyed by it. Once per casting, however many enemies are caught, the Slime heals 100 hit points.
Void Maw: Beelzebub

At 20th level, the Slime awakens as the ultimate apex predator of the multiverse. You gain Damage Reduction 15/-, a +4 size bonus to Constitution, and gain the active ability {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}Void Maw: Beelzebub{/g} three times per day.
Beelzebub: Lord of Devourers

Besmara, known as the Pirate Queen, is the fierce goddess of piracy, sea monsters, strife, and audacious maritime chaos.
Sailing across the planar currents of the Astral Plane and the Great Beyond, she cares nothing for stuffy mortal laws, chivalric oaths, or orderly crusades. She loves the thrill of danger, daring wagers, and violent plunder. In the Constellation Chat, Besmara cheers wildly whenever you take reckless gambles or slice down formidable demons with flashy precision.
Domains: Chaos, War, Trickery, Water
Favoured Weapon: Rapier
Besmara

The Black Butterfly, also revered as the Silence Between the Stars, is the shadow of Desna born when starlight first broke the eternal dark of the Great Beyond.
She watches over the desolate voids of the Dark Tapestry, bringing solace to the isolated and quietly defending mortal realms from ancient horrors beyond space.
Her followers value silence, contemplation, and the freedom of forgotten wanderers.
Domains: Darkness, Liberation, Protection, Good
Favoured Weapon: Starknife
The Black Butterfly

Make a melee touch attack against an adjacent living creature. On a hit it takes 1d6 unholy damage plus 1d6 per 2 character levels and 1 point of Constitution damage, and you heal hit points equal to the unholy damage dealt. Usable 3 times per day.
Blood Drain
Emits a 30-foot aura of selfless fellowship empowering nearby allies.
Bonds of Fellowship Aura
Fighting alongside the Hero inspires true courage. Allies within 30 feet receive a +2 Sacred bonus to attack rolls, Armor Class, and saving throws.
Bonds of Fellowship
At 3rd level, the Hero's unwavering devotion to their companions manifests as an aura of fellowship. Allies within 30 feet receive a +2 Sacred bonus to attack, AC, and all saving throws.
Grants a permanent +4 profane bonus to Strength and Constitution.
Boon of Abyssal Rage (Demon)
Grants +2d6 sneak attack damage.
Boon of the Cosmic Jester (Trickster)
Grants a permanent +4 inherent bonus to all 6 ability scores.
Boon of the Golden Dragon (Gold Dragon)
Grants a permanent +4 sacred bonus to AC and a +7 sacred bonus to damage rolls.
Boon of the Heavenly Host (Angel)
Grants fire resistance 100.
Boon of Hellfire Contract (Devil)
Grants permanent DR 10/adamantite.
Boon of the Lord of Bones (Lich)
Grants a permanent +4 insight bonus to attack rolls and AC, plus immunity to mind-affecting effects.
Boon of Monadic Order (Aeon)
Grants permanent DR 10/- and 20% concealment.
Boon of the Primeval Swarm (Swarm)
Grants a permanent +4 bonus to all saving throws and all ability scores.
Boon of the Unbound Mortal (Legend)
Grants a permanent +3 morale bonus to all saving throws and +1 extra attack per round that stacks with Haste.
Boon of Wild Wonder (Azata)
Grants immunity to fatigue and exhaustion, and a +2 morale bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Cayden's Reserve Brew

The God Emperor's oath. The domain becomes heaven's own mandate and the crown becomes a throne. Heavenly Imperial Mandate replaces Transcendent Domain at 5th level: allies within 40 feet gain +6 to attack rolls, AC and saving throws. Heavenly Throne replaces Crown of Stories at 9th level: +4 Charisma and +2 to your spell save DCs. Only a God Emperor can swear it; everything else is the Transcendent Sovereign's.
Celestial Monarch

Chaldira Zuzaristan, known as the Calamitous Turn and the Mischievous Friend, is the halfling goddess of battle, luck, daring mischief, and plucky underdogs.
A close friend and companion to Desna, Chaldira charges headlong into danger, trusting in boundless optimism, cheeky tricks, and sheer miraculous luck to see her through.
In the Constellation Chat, Chaldira is always rooting for the underdog hero, giggling at unexpected critical hits, and playfully teasing Desna and Cayden Cailean.
Domains: Good, Chaos, Trickery, Luck
Favoured Weapon: Shortsword
Chaldira Zuzaristan
Grants a +2 bonus on critical confirmation rolls, a +2 luck bonus to initiative, and a +2 bonus to all saving throws that stacks with everything, including Plot Armor.
Chaldira's Audacious Fortune

Your connection to the timeline ensures that lethal defeat rewinds reality. When your HP drops to 0, you are instantly resurrected to full HP, vigor, and gain Greater Invisibility and Haste for 2 rounds.
Return by Death Ready

Like a cursed traveler bound to a mysterious witch, death is not an ending for you. 
Benefit: Once per rest, when your HP drops to 0, reality snaps backward: you are resurrected with 100% HP and gain Greater Invisibility and Haste for 2 rounds to turn the tide of battle.
Overpowered Ability - Cheat Death (Return by Death)

You maintain an otherworldly journal recording your landmark victories across Golarion. As you conquer pivotal story dungeons and chapter climaxes, you unlock passive transmigrator adventuring bonuses and ancient skill books.
Chronicle of the Otherworld
Will negates stasis (staggered on save)

You declare dominion over the flow of time itself. As a swift action, force all enemies within 60 ft to make a Will saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier). On a failure, they are frozen in absolute temporal stasis for 2 rounds. On a success, they are staggered for 1 round by the temporal distortion. Usable once per day (gains a second use at level 15).
Overpowered Ability - Chrono Domain (Time Stop)

Time is not a cage that binds you; it is a tapestry you can pause at will. 
Benefit: Grants the Chrono Domain ability (1/day, 2/day at level 15) to freeze or stagger all nearby enemies in time as a swift action.
Hey! Listen! Watch out ahead, Hero!

The Hero's partner: a floating orb of golden fairy light and temporal magic who never stops giving advice. She carries no weapon; she speeds up her allies' timelines instead, and grows through temporal pulse and timeline evasion milestones.
Chrono Sprite
Hey! Listen! {master}, watch out ahead!
C'mon, {master}, time is ticking! We've got a world to save!
I've got your back, Hero! Let's show them what hope looks like!
Time loops or demon lords, nothing can stop us together!
Phew! Good job, {master}! Another timeline secured!
We did it! That was amazing, Hero!
Haha! Did you see how fast we moved?!
Hey! Listen! Danger approaching!
Time to show them what a true Hero can do!
Stay focused, {master}! Fast feet, sharp blade!
Energetic guidance and temporal cheer of the Chrono Sprite.
Chrono Sprite Voice
Morning, {master}! No sword swings before breakfast, okay? Even legendary heroes need to eat! *giggles*
I kept a temporal watch all night! Nothing crept up, or I'd have buzzed right in your ear!
Rise and shine, Hero! Today's going to be another adventure!
Chrono Sprite (Fairy of Time)
Hides the internal skull skeleton, allowing the Chrono Sprite to manifest as a pure, floating orb of luminescent fairy light.
Chrono Sprite Fairy Glow

[Hero Archetype Exclusive Partner]
A luminous, floating orb of golden fairy light and temporal magic who never stops buzzing with advice.
'Hey! Listen!' she cries, accelerating the timelines of allies and granting constant Haste fields.

{g|Encyclopedia:Size}Size{/g}: Diminutive
{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}Speed{/g}: 40 ft. (Flying)
{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}: +6 natural armor
{g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}Starting ability scores{/g}: Str 8, Dex 24, Con 14, Int 16, Wis 18, Cha 18
Advances 1-20 in Guardian Class with temporal pulse and timeline evasion milestones.
★ Chrono Sprite (Hero Exclusive)
The fairy emits a rhythmic pulse of accelerated time, providing a continuous Haste effect to all allies within 20 feet.
Chrono Pulse Field
Allies within 20 feet gain the benefits of Haste: +1 extra attack on full attack, +30 ft movement speed, and +1 dodge AC.
Temporal Haste Field
The Chrono Sprite flits ahead of danger, providing tactical alerts. Gains a +4 dodge bonus to AC, +4 bonus on Initiative, and immunity to ground hazards.
Hey! Listen! Temporal Guidance
[Hero Exclusive] Attune with the Chrono Sprite to guide your timelines, scaling 1:1 to your character level, up to 20th. You retain all Solo Sovereign bonuses.
Pact: Chrono Sprite (Fairy of Time)
Progression for the Hero of Time's Chrono Sprite familiar.
Chrono Sprite Progression
Mastering the flow of time, the Chrono Sprite gains Fast Healing 10 and a +6 luck bonus to AC.
Avatar of Heroic Timelines
The sprite shifts partially out of phase with present reality, gaining 50% concealment against all attacks, immunity to flanking, and a +4 luck bonus on Reflex and Will saving throws.
Timeline Evasion

Chosen as a conduit of divine majesty, you channel cosmic faith into miracles of restoration and righteous retribution. Your prayers command domain authority and celestial energy that blesses your allies and sears the unholy.
Cleric Legacy - Voice of the Pantheon

The Mastermind's partner: an immortal advisor bound by an otherworldly contract, who watches the chessboard of fate with unreadable calm, shields the Mastermind's mind and demands eccentric snacks. She fights with light blades and bows (simple and martial weapons) and grows through cognitive link and command protocol milestones.
Enigmatic Co-Conspirator

{n}A rift of swirling astral light coalesces into a gilded amphitheater platform. Before you stands an otherworldly herald clad in starlit robes, bowing with theatrical grace.{/n}

"Greetings, champion beyond worlds! Welcome to the Planar Coliseum, where travelers from across the multiverse test their mettle before the observing constellations. What is your desire?"

{n}Briars of luminous thorn have overgrown streets that belong to no city on Golarion, and fey lanterns drift above the cobbles. A herald in starlit robes bows with theatrical grace.{/n}

"Welcome to the Fae Grove, the first stage of the Planar Coliseum, where the First World's tricksters test newcomers before the watching constellations. What is your desire, champion?"

{n}Broken banners of crusades long lost stand in the grey dust, and the wind carries the clatter of old armor. A herald in starlit robes waits among the cairns.{/n}

"Welcome to the Lost Legions, where the fallen of forgotten crusades still march for the constellations. Honor them, or join them. What is your desire, champion?"

{n}Cracks of red light split the scorched earth beneath a sky that is always midnight. A herald in starlit robes bows from the edge of the ring.{/n}

"Welcome to the Midnight Colosseum, where demons fight for the favor of the stars and champions fight for their lives. What is your desire?"

{n}The rock here is too quiet. Past the canyon's rim the sky simply ends, and the dark beyond it drinks the light. A herald in starlit robes stands at the lip of nothing.{/n}

"Welcome to the Void Rift, a shard of the coliseum torn loose and adrift between the Abyss and the stars. Whatever falls from here is not missed. What is your desire, champion?"

{n}The canyon walls shimmer with reflections of other skies, other wars and other versions of this very moment. A herald in starlit robes waits where the reflections meet.{/n}

"Welcome to the Multiverse Threshold, the last stage of the Planar Coliseum, where champions of every timeline meet. Win here, and cups older than the gods open to you. What is your desire?"
Win the Fae Grove Cup in the Planar Coliseum's first arena. Its rift waits on the Kenabres map beside Defender's Heart, and in the Defender's Heart tavern.
Act 1: The Fae Grove
Win the Lost Legions Cup in the arena of forgotten crusades. Its rift waits on the Worldwound map and at the crusader war camp.
Act 2: The Lost Legions
Win the Midnight Colosseum Cup, where demon gladiators defend the coliseum's heart. Its rift waits on the Worldwound map beside Drezen.
Act 3: The Midnight Colosseum

Win the Void Rift Cup at the edge of nothing. No road leads there from the Midnight Isles: the Otherworldly Emissary carries the rift, and waits in Alushinyrra's lower, middle and upper city. The Act 5 arena replays its cup.
Act 4: The Void Rift
Win the Multiverse Threshold Cup, where every timeline's coliseum touches. Its rift waits on the Worldwound map beside Drezen.
Act 5: The Multiverse Threshold
Every arena's cup is yours.
Champion of the Planar Coliseum
You spit a globule of living acidic slime as a ranged touch attack. Deals 1d6 acid damage per 4 caster levels (up to 10d6 at level 40), and reduces the target's spell resistance by 2 for 2 rounds.
Corrosive Slime
Target suffers a -2 penalty to spell resistance for 2 rounds.
Slime Corrosion
Dark Triforce resonance radiates from your silhouette, sharpening every strike you make. You gain a +2 profane bonus to attack rolls.
Aura of Calamity Dread
Your master sword is infused with malice and dark miasma. Weapon attacks deal an additional 2d6 unholy damage on hit.
Blade of Calamity
The despair of everything that has fallen before you fuels your dark sovereignty. You gain a +2 profane bonus to weapon damage.
Bonds of Domination
You claim the inverted Dark Triforce. Grants a +4 profane bonus to Strength and Charisma.
Dark Triforce Sovereign
Piercing through mortal illusions, you gain permanent True Seeing and can never be blinded.
Eye of the Calamity Void
You refuse the preordained cycle of reincarnation and defeat. Grants immunity to death effects, paralysis, and energy drain, and increases all weapon critical multipliers by 1.
Shattered Cycle of the Hero

The inverted Song of Time runs through you constantly rather than being played. Time slips for everything around you: you gain a +2 profane bonus to Armor Class and a +10 foot enhancement bonus to movement speed.
Song of the Shattered Moon

Protected by an otherworldly cosmic sanctuary: gain damage reduction equal to half the character level of the Isekai who radiates the aura and spell resistance equal to 12 + that level. The damage reduction does not stack with other damage reduction.
Cosmic Aegis Sanctuary

Requires Level 21+. You radiate an impenetrable cosmic aegis in a 30-foot aura. Allies within this aura gain damage reduction equal to half your character level and spell resistance equal to 12 + your character level (the aura owner's level, not the ally's). The damage reduction does not stack with other damage reduction, and the spell resistance applies to friendly magic as well.
Epic Overpowered Ability - Cosmic Aegis

You have forged an eternal pact with the Astral Sovereign Dragon, an ancient silver dragon.
Benefit: Once per day, you can summon the Astral Sovereign Dragon to fight at your side for 1 hour.
Cosmic Companion: Astral Sovereign Dragon
Blow the horn to permanently unlock the daily summon of the Astral Sovereign Dragon, an ancient silver dragon.
Astral Sovereign Dragon Horn

A carved iridescent horn from an astral leviathan.
Permanently unlocks the daily summoning of the Astral Sovereign Dragon, an ancient silver dragon, for 1 hour.
Summons the Astral Sovereign Dragon, an ancient silver dragon, to fight at your side for 1 hour. The dragon wields breath attacks, magic, and terrifying natural attacks.
Summon Astral Sovereign Dragon
Every time you cast a spell, it becomes quickened regardless of spell level (1st through 10th level spells), as though using the Quicken Spell feat. Requires character level 21.
Cosmic Quicken Matrix

Five challenging optional cosmic anomalies, one per chapter of the crusade, wait in places of their own: a Barren Anomaly on the world map for each, and the Otherworldly Emissary in the Midnight Isles and at the Threshold. Each of them pays its Cosmic Coin bounty once per playthrough; a rematch is always available and pays a tenth of the normal experience and no coins.
Cosmic Barren Encounters

You declare absolute dominion over the flow of time itself. As a swift action, freeze all enemies within 60 ft in absolute temporal stasis for 2 rounds with no saving throw. Creatures immune to paralysis are unaffected, and spell resistance still applies. Affected foes cannot act or evade attacks. Usable once per day (gains a second use at level 15).
Chronos Absolute Stasis

Time is not a cage that binds you; it is a tapestry you can pause at will.
Benefit: Grants the Chronos Absolute Stasis ability (1/day, 2/day at level 15) to freeze all nearby enemies in time for 2 rounds as a swift action with no saving throw.
[Haggler Discount] Haggled price reduced from {0} to {1} Cosmic Coins (-{2}%, Saved: {3})!
[Cosmic Sponsorship] Insufficient Cosmic Coins! Required: {0}, Current: {1}
<color=#133E71>[NG+ x{0}]</color>
[Cosmic Sponsorship] You received +{0} Cosmic Coins{1}! (Balance: {2})
[Cosmic Sponsorship] Spent {0} Cosmic Coins. (Remaining Balance: {1})
[Cosmic Sponsorship] {0} has sponsored you +{1} Cosmic Coins{2}! (Balance: {3})

An astral crown forged from condensed stellar supernovas.
Grants a +6 enhancement bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, a +2 insight bonus to all spell save DCs, and spell resistance 10.
Cosmic Relic: Crown of Apotheosis
Crown of Apotheosis
Requires Level 21+. Your presence bends planar authority. You gain a +4 untyped bonus to all spell save DCs, attack rolls, Armor Class, and saving throws.
Prestige OP Ability - Cosmic Dominion
Permanently grants +20 maximum hit points.
Cosmic Fortitude Infusion
Consumes the cosmic pact to permanently awaken absolute caster and martial authority.
Rulebreaker Mythic Pact

You have purchased the absolute authority of the cosmos to dictate your own destiny.
Grants a +3 bonus to your Caster Level for all spells, a +4 sacred bonus to all attack rolls, and +4 sacred bonus to all damage rolls.
Cosmic Boon: Rulebreaker Mythic Pact

You have purchased the absolute authority of the cosmos to dictate your own destiny.
Permanently grants a +3 bonus to your Caster Level for all spells, a +4 sacred bonus to all attack rolls, and +4 sacred bonus to all damage rolls.

A cosmic ring that allows its wearer to slip through the seams of physical reality.
Grants permanent immunity to paralysis and to being held in place, a +5 deflection bonus to Armor Class, and a +5 sacred bonus to all saving throws.
Cosmic Relic: Ring of Omnipresence
Ring of Omnipresence

Allows you to commune with the observing constellations and redeem accumulated Cosmic Coins through a celestial store interface, offering divine blessings, mythic boons, web novel elixirs, modular wishes, cosmic infusions, and avatar ascensions.
Cosmic Sponsorship Exchange
[Cosmic Ascension] You already embody {0}. Nothing was spent.
<color=#7A1010>[Cosmic Store]</color> You already possess this permanent cosmic boon!
[AVATAR ASCENSION!] The skies split with divine brilliance: you now embody {0}!
[Cosmic Ascension] {0} leaves you with your old fealty. Avatars are not refunded.

[The Cosmic Constellation Exchange] Soft starlight crystallizes around you into a shimmering celestial interface. The observing constellations watch with eager anticipation as your accumulated Cosmic Coins hum with multiversal energy. Select a catalog category below: Your balance: {isekai_cosmic_coins} Cosmic Coins

You have completely shattered mortal limitations, achieving transcendent perfection in body and mind infused with powers from a deity. 
Benefit: Gain an initial +5 untyped bonus to all attributes. Additionally, gain +1 untyped bonus to all attributes for every 4 character levels and +1 for every 2 mythic ranks, to a maximum of +15 in total.
Crown of the Supreme Entity
To challenge an otherworldly protagonist whose power defies reality, this creature has been adapted by cosmic destiny with enhanced combat reflexes, armor class, and saving throws.
Cosmic Threat Scaling

Tokens of cosmic favor bestowed upon you by observing deities and higher planar entities.
These tokens are awarded when deities celebrate your choices, audacious swagger, or heroic triumphs.
They can be redeemed through the Cosmic Sponsorship Exchange for divine boons, sacred elixirs, and otherworldly relics.
Cosmic Coins
An alchemical coinage foundry powered by otherworldly transmutative magic. It turns base ores into coin for the crusade's treasury.
Generates +75 Finances per day. Only one can be built in the whole crusade.
Cosmic Transmutation Mint

The Overlord's iconic frontline creation. Summons a heavy-armored Death Knight vanguard for 1 minute per character level. The Death Knight is an armored front-liner with a +6 natural armor bonus from {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}Indomitable Wall{/g}. Usable 1 + Charisma modifier times per day; at most 2 of your Death Knights stand at once, and a new one dismisses the oldest.
Create High Tier Undead: Death Knight
At 3rd level, the Overlord can summon a loyal Death Knight vanguard into battle, 1 + Charisma modifier times per day, with at most 2 standing at once.
"One stage of the Planar Coliseum. Each chapter of your crusade has its own, and each keeps its own cup."

"A grove the fey grew over the memory of a burning city. The First World remembers what mortals forget, and it dresses its memories in thorns. Satyrs, redcaps and a Hamadryad Queen keep the Fae Grove Cup, and they fight to amuse, not to kill. Mostly."

"Every crusade that ever marched into the Worldwound left someone behind, and the constellations gathered the ones nobody buried. Ghouls, wights and the champions of dead legions hold the Lost Legions Cup. Beat them, and they rest a while."
"The coliseum's heart. Demon gladiators from a hundred Abyssal pits bargain for a place on these sands, and the Midnight Colosseum Cup is theirs to defend."

"A piece of the coliseum that broke away and fell toward the Abyss, and never finished falling. Mariliths, vavakia and balors climb out of the dark to test anyone who stands at its edge. Hold the Void Rift Cup, and the void itself takes notice."

"The place where every timeline's coliseum touches. The Multiverse Threshold Cup is fought against the mightiest things the constellations can borrow from other worlds. Conquer it, and the Astral Cup, the Genesis Cup and the Cosmic Challenge open beyond it."
"The sands are patient, champion. What else is your desire?"

"Which cup do you wish to conquer? A cup pays its full purse of gold, experience and Cosmic Coins the first time you win it. Each victory after that pays a tenth of the gold and experience and a quarter of the coins, never fewer than 25."
"A withdrawal is no disgrace, champion. Some adversaries refuse to fall by any honest means." The herald claps once, and the ring empties.
"May the constellations illuminate your journey, champion. The coliseum shall await your return."

"The coliseum stands anchored in the dimensional nexus between Golarion and divergent timelines. The constellations (Desna, Gorum, Iomedae, Calistria, Nethys, Asmodeus, the Lantern King, and Yog-Sothoth himself) watch your feats from the heavens, rewarding mortal champions who push past the boundaries of destiny."
"May the constellations preserve your strength. Until next time, champion!"
"Certainly! Step right this way to the relic vault."
{n}Below the tavern a stone archway glows with soft starlight. As you step closer the veil between planes parts, and somewhere beyond it a crowd roars for the champions of the Planar Coliseum.{/n}
"May the stars guide your path, champion."
"Cosmic Coins are awarded for conquering tournament cups in this coliseum, defeating rift bosses, progressing through New Game+ cycles, achieving milestones, and issuing commercial crusade decrees."
"Behold the treasures of the cosmos."
"Step through the threshold, champion. May the constellations favor your courage."
"As you will, champion. The rift endures whenever you are ready."

"An interdimensional gladiatorial hub outside linear time, with a stage for every chapter of your crusade. You will find the Herald of the Planar Coliseum, who registers champions for the tournament cups, the Astral Coin Envoy, who trades relics for Cosmic Coins, a smuggler dealing in planar contraband, and the High Oracle of the Constellations."
"The cosmos remains with you, always."

"Desna's song, Gorum's fury, Iomedae's righteousness, Calistria's venom, Nethys's duality, Asmodeus's order, the Lantern King's mischief, and Yog-Sothoth's timeless gate. When you fight, they all bear witness."
"Let the divine resonance wash over your soul."
"Come back when your bags are heavier. I never close up shop."
"Who said anything about the Worldwound? I siphon supplies straight from the Astral Plane and dead empires across the Great Beyond. The crusaders fight in mud; we deal in cosmic supremacy."
"Gold talks, friend. Take a look at this lot."
{n}The starlight enfolds you and lifts you beyond the Worldwound's blighted soil. Somewhere ahead, a crowd roars for the champions of the Planar Coliseum.{/n}

Break it if you can."

{n}Camellia shivers slightly, eyeing you with restrained disdain and curiosity.{/n} "Reincarnated? You hit your head quite hard, didn't you? Get your bearings. We need to find a way back to the surface before whatever lurks down here smells our blood."

{n}Galfrey shivers as an icy, necromantic weight settles over the stone battlement, yet she holds your gaze with queenly resolve.{/n} "An unyielding necropolis in the heart of the Worldwound... Rule it with the justice you promised."

(Shadow Monarch) [Raise the Citadel of Eternal Shadows] "Let the sun set on the old world. Drezen is now the Citadel of Eternal Shadows, where the silent legion stands eternal guard over northern Avistan."

{n}Galfrey looks out at the darkening towers, where silhouettes of shadow soldiers stand vigilant along the parapets.{/n} "The demons took Drezen through light and fire, but they will never break through your shadows. (Slime) [Proclaim the Tempest Multiverse Federation] "Drezen is now the capital of the Tempest Multiverse Federation! Hot springs, good food, and a home for mortals, mongrels, and reformed fiends alike!"

{n}Queen Galfrey pauses, looking across the liberated citadel walls with a faint, bemused smile.{/n} "A... multiverse federation? With hot springs and monster sanctuaries?
