(Martial God) [Meditative Boundary: The Boundary Hermit] "I will retire to a tranquil pocket dimension on the astral fringe and perfect the singular transcendent strike of true enlightenment."
{n}You picture yourself seated in quiet contemplation between planes, refining the perfect cut until, at the moment of enlightenment, the cosmic clock chimes and time gently rewinds.{/n}

(Hero) [Fallen Paragon: The Corrupted Champion] "I have lived long enough to become the villain. I close my hand on the Triforce of Power, and in the name of protecting everyone I will enforce absolute peace with an iron fist."

{n}Something dark takes root beneath your righteousness as the mark of Power settles into your hand. Let them fear your goodness, just as they once feared the demons. Whichever path you swore to on the day you were called here, it is Power that answers you at the end.{/n}
(God Emperor) [Conquest of Two Realms: The Dual Throne of Sun and Abyss] "I will march the solar legions into the Abyss and bind mortal and fiend under the supremacy of the Dual Throne."
{n}You see solar banners planted in abyssal magma, and mortals and demons alike kneeling before your absolute authority across two planes.{/n}
(Isekai Protagonist) [Surrender to the Broadcast: The Eternal Actor] "Let the Constellations have their eternal show. When this era fades, let the causal clock rewind for another season."
{n}You bow to the empty sky. Somewhere beyond it an unseen audience roars, and the causal clock begins, very quietly, to wind itself back.{/n}

(Hero) [Celestial Nova: The Sovereign Beacon of Eternal Hope] "I reach for the Triforce of Courage! I will channel the hope of every mortal who ever lived into an undying nova and ascend as the eternal protector of worlds!"

{n}An impossible, blinding light gathers around you, and the mark of Courage burns gold across the back of your hand. To become a beacon for all dimensions is an endless sacrifice, and you accept it gladly. Whichever path you swore to on the day you were called here, it is Courage that answers you at the end.{/n}
(Mastermind) [Unseen Maestro: The Immortal Philanthropist] "With my immortality and foresight, I will quietly resolve every crisis before blood is spilled and guide centuries of prosperity."
{n}The board lays itself out before you: wars solved before they ignite, history guided from behind the curtain like a flawless game of chess, and centuries of quiet flourishing.{/n}
(Martial God) [Astral Severance: The Edge of Infinite Horizons] "When this is done, my blade will cut a path into the Astral Plane, and I will ascend there as the God of the Sword!"

{n}Your phantom blade hums in its sheath. In a single transcendent draw you can already see the astral expanse opening, and yourself standing there as the supreme deity of the blade, guarding planar wanderers.{/n}
(Isekai Protagonist) [Slipstream Wanderer: The Interdimensional Traveler] "When this is done, I step into the dimensional slipstream to explore the Great Beyond and leave Golarion in mortal hands."
{n}The violet flames of the Wound bend around your otherworldly mana as you gather it for the crossing still to come. Beyond this last choice, the stars are waiting.{/n}
(Overlord) [Isolated Bastion: Dominion of the Iron Citadel] "I will raise obsidian ramparts around Sarkoris and isolate our necropolis from the petty squabbles of the outside world."
{n}You picture it clearly: obsidian walls closing around a silent necropolis. A sanctuary of undeath, and a quiet, lifeless prison of your own making.{/n}
(Overlord) [Total Harvest: The Eternal Necro-Tyrant] "Mortal life is a fragile, chaotic disease. I will harvest every living soul in Avistan into a silent, disciplined undead legion."
{n}A chilling vision sweeps over you: a necrotic storm across northern Avistan, life falling silent, and every soul rising in flawless, eternal obedience to the Great Tomb.{/n}
(Shadow Monarch) [Eternal Void: The Netherworld Cataclysm] "I will open the Netherworld across Avistan and drown the continent in an eternal black void where only shadows live."
{n}A cold vision fills your mind: a sun that never rises again, and northern Avistan sinking into a silent realm where shadows walk the earth forever.{/n}
(Mastermind) [Cold Simulation: The NPC Simulator] "Mortals, demons, and gods are mere NPCs on a board. I will farm their interactions and treat this reality as my private playground."
{n}Detached from mortal sentiment, you already see kingdoms and fiends as pieces to move for optimal entertainment, and the multiverse as a sandbox built for your amusement.{/n}
(Shadow Monarch) [The Shadow Gate: The Obsidian Bastion] "Whatever becomes of the Wound, I will raise the Shadow Gate and sit upon the threshold, so neither demon nor conqueror ever crosses."
{n}You picture an immense black monolith at the boundary between planes, and yourself seated upon its obsidian throne, the eternal gatekeeper between realities.{/n}

(Overlord) [Sovereign Protectorate: Pax Sepulchrum] "Whatever becomes of the Wound, Sarkoris falls under the protectorate of the Great Tomb. The dead shall labor and defend so the living may prosper."

{n}For a moment you glimpse the future you have claimed: disciplined death knights and bone laborers spread across Sarkoris, and an era of impeccable order, rich harvests and zero crime begins under the Supreme One's impartial gaze.{/n}
(God Emperor) [Solar Renaissance: Pax Solaris] "I will ascend the Golden Throne of Sarkoris as God-King and usher in an era of solar technology, justice, and prosperity!"

{n}For a moment you glimpse the future you have claimed: radiant solar towers rising from Drezen to the World's Edge Mountains, and a Solar Commonwealth uniting the nations in an era of cultural and scientific enlightenment.{/n}
(Slime) [Ancient Slumber: The Primeval Marsh] "I will return Sarkoris to a wild primeval haven and curl up beneath the World Tree as Golarion's guardian beast-god."
{n}The thought is strangely peaceful: a beast-god asleep beneath the World Tree, while the wild slowly reclaims Sarkoris around you.{/n}

(Hero) [Humble Peace: The Retired Legend] "I refuse godhood and crowns. The Triforce of Wisdom asks for neither courage nor power, only the sense to put the blade down. When this is over, I will open a cozy tavern and training hall in Kenabres and live a full mortal life."

{n}After holding the power to shape reality, you find yourself dreaming of pouring ale and telling stories. Wisdom is the piece that never asked you to be the bravest or the strongest, and this is the best dream you have had in years.{/n}
(God Emperor) [Iron Mandate: The Sarkorian Imperium] "I will forge the Sarkorian Imperium and rule Avistan through unassailable military discipline and absolute law."
{n}You see imperial legions marching to every border, bringing absolute stability and commercial dominance under your unwavering authority.{/n}
(Martial God) [Reality Fracture: The Severed Horizon] "I will strike reality too deeply, sever the metaphysical thread of Golarion, and watch existence dissolve into iridescent static."
{n}For an instant you feel how the blade could cut too deep: the world unraveling like silk into glowing static, and you standing alone in the void.{/n}
(Mastermind) [Information Sovereign: The Shadow Syndicate] "I will erase every record of my existence and build an invisible broker network that keeps the world's economy and politics stable."
{n}You picture your name vanishing from histories and songs, and an unassuming office in a peaceful city where you keep the ledger that discreetly governs world affairs.{/n}
(Shadow Monarch) [Watchers in the Dark: The Silent Aegis of Shadows] "I will command the Legion of Shadows to shield Golarion, so night becomes a guardian rather than a terror."
{n}You picture shadow soldiers standing silent, invisible guard over every road and hamlet, while innocents sleep peacefully under the sovereign darkness of the Netherworld.{/n}
(Slime) [Multiversal Haven: The Tempest Multiverse Federation] "Whatever happens to the Wound, these scarred lands become the Tempest Multiverse Federation, where all beings live and feast together!"
{n}A profound, comforting warmth radiates from you as you picture it: monsters and mortals sharing one table, and hot springs steaming where the demons once marched.{/n}
(Isekai Protagonist) [Shatter the Cosmic Loop: The Unwritten Dawn] "I reach for the Keys of Causal Rupture! Yog-Sothoth, let us see whether your playback ends today!"

{n}The Keys of Causal Rupture stir in answer, straining against the invisible temporal anchors that hold this era in recurrence. Whether they break will be decided by everything you have done, not by what you say here.{/n}

Reincarnated with the supernatural ability to see, pluck, and reweave the invisible threads of fate and chance. Fateweavers slip effortlessly past impossible odds and strike where destiny is most vulnerable.
The Fateweaver Halfling gains a +4 racial bonus to Dexterity and a +2 racial bonus to Charisma, which replace the halfling's ability score adjustments, and +2d6 sneak attack damage.
Supernal Luck: a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls and a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.
Shadow Step: 3 times per day, as a swift action, teleport to a location within close range.
Fateweaver Halfling

(Slime) [Proclaim the Tempest Way] "Why must everything be an ultimatum? In the Tempest Federation we protect our friends, build cozy homes, and eat good food. Keep your dogmas; we're fixing this our way!"

{n}Iomedae blinks, momentarily disarmed by your earnest, cheerful declaration.{/n} "A cozy home... and good food? You speak of simple mortal peace in the face of planar destruction. If your strange federation can truly restore peace to these tortured lands, then prove it at Threshold, Commander."
(God Emperor) [Declare Sovereign Autarchy] "The era of foreign gods deciding mortal destinies ends today. The Golden Throne of Sarkoris shall not kneel to Heaven nor Hell. My reign is absolute."

{n}Iomedae looks upon you with solemn gravity.{/n} "Many mortal kings have proclaimed absolute autarchy, only to fall to hubris. If you claim the throne of Sarkoris, rule with righteousness, not tyranny."

(Isekai Protagonist) [Reject Divine Scripts for Mortal Freedom] "Neither blind faith nor abyssal chains! My power is my own, and my companions'. I reject both your scripts and will shatter this loop myself!"

{n}Iomedae stares at you in solemn, awe-struck sorrow, while Nocticula watches with breathless admiration.{/n} "To reject both Heaven and the Abyss... to cast aside the divine design in the name of unguided mortal will. It is a path of terrible peril, Commander. Yet the purity of your conviction rivals that of the greatest martyrs of old. May your mortal spirit withstand the storm to come."
(Mastermind) [Expose the Binary False Choice] "A classic false dichotomy: sacrificial obsolescence or parasitic dependency. Both algorithms fail. I select Option Three: mortal transcendence."

{n}Nocticula laughs with sharp, appreciative brilliance.{/n} "Parasitic dependency? Oh, you wound me, Commander! But I cannot fault a mind so delightfully immune to divine coercion. Show us your Option Three, then!"

(Overlord) [Castigate Both Goddesses] "A goddess preaching submission and a demon queen whispering seduction. Neither of you commands a Supreme Being. The Worldwound shall be sealed by my decree alone."
"Let {mf|him|her} speak, Inheritor! A tyrant who looks down on both heaven and hell is far more amusing than your pious sermons."
{n}Iomedae's radiant sword blazes with righteous indignation, while Nocticula chuckles softly into her sleeve.{/n} "Supreme Being? Your pride borders on the greatest heresies of the ancient world!"
(Shadow Monarch) [Embrace the Sovereign Eclipse] "Light and lust are equally fleeting. When the battle for Threshold begins, neither Heaven nor Alushinyrra will hold the line. My shadows will."

{n}Iomedae tightens her grip on her holy blade as shadows swallow the stones of the summit.{/n} "The dark power you harbor is perilous beyond measure, Commander. Do not let the shadows you command become your own tomb."
(Isekai Protagonist) [Check the Live Chat Banter] "Hold on! Live chat is going wild! 40% for Iomedae, 50% for Nocticula, and 10% betting I flip both of you off! Let's give them a show!"
{n}Nocticula smirks with wicked delight.{/n} "I don't know what a live chat is, Commander, but I adore being the crowd favorite. Keep entertaining the cosmos!"

{n}Both deities pause in sheer, profound bewilderment as holographic reaction emojis and coin donations flash across the air.{/n} "Live chat? Constellation betting pools? What manner of alien madness is this?!"
(Slime) "Easy with the polearm, sir! I just woke up starving after that terrible carriage accident. I came to the square looking for festival skewers and pastries, not an inquisition."

{n}Hulrun glares at you with stern suspicion.{/n} "Starving? You were dragged in with a wound in your chest and you think of pastries? A carriage, you say. Coming from where?" {n}You try to recall the road, but nothing comes.{/n}
(God Emperor) "You speak to an emperor whose ascension will eclipse the heavens. Lower your halberd before your sovereign, Prelate, and remember your place."

{n}Hulrun stumbles backward half a pace as a radiant, suffocating pressure radiates from your mantle.{/n} "What madness is this... an emperor? In Kenabres? Then name your realm, your Majesty." {n}You open your mouth, but no name comes to you.{/n}
(Hero) "I came here to stand with the protectors of this city, not to cause trouble. Lower your halberd, Prelate. We should be celebrating with the townsfolk, not drawing steel."

{n}Hulrun sighs heavily, lowering his halberd by a fraction of an inch.{/n} "Idealistic words. Every young recruit arrives in Kenabres believing courage alone will win this crusade. Which order sent you, then? Who is your commander?" {n}You try to answer, but the names will not come.{/n}
(Mastermind) "Interrogating a concussed patient yields useless data, Prelate Hulrun. You have glanced at the city gates three times in a minute; your focus is wasted on an unarmed stranger."

{n}Hulrun glares at you with suspicion, clearly unsettled by your clinical deduction.{/n} "Deductions and statistics? You speak like an aloof scholar from some eastern academy. Which academy, then? And what is your name?" {n}For all your clarity, you find no memory of either.{/n}
(Overlord) "You dare interrogate an Overlord, mortal? Be grateful my unfathomable mercy permits your insignificant spark of life to continue burning."

{n}Hulrun shudders as a cold, necrotic chill sweeps across the stones of the square.{/n} "Such insolence! By Iomedae's light, you speak like a tyrant from some forgotten age. Which land do you claim to rule?" {n}The answer should be obvious, yet your memory offers only fog.{/n}
(Martial God) "Lower that halberd, Prelate. I just woke up in this square, and waving polearms at recovering patients is hardly proper festival etiquette."

{n}Hulrun's brows knit at your flippant tone.{/n} "Woke up here? You were carried into this square half dead, stranger. Where were you before that? Who brought you to Kenabres?" {n}You reach for the answer, but your memory gives you nothing.{/n}
(Shadow Monarch) "My pulse is steady and my memory is clearing, Prelate. The only shadows following me are the ones your festival banners cast on the cobblestones."

{n}The shadows beneath Hulrun's boots seem to go still as you meet his gaze, and the veteran pauses.{/n} "You speak quietly, yet there is an unnatural coldness in your eyes. Clearing, is it? Then tell me where you came from." {n}You search for the answer, but it slips away.{/n}

Otherworldly souls who are reincarnated as Immortal Humans possess an unyielding life force anchored to higher planes. Their wounds continuously knit closed, making them nearly impossible to permanently fell in battle.
Immortal Humans have a +4 racial bonus to Constitution, a +2 racial bonus to Charisma, a +2 racial bonus on Fortitude saves, and a +4 racial bonus on saving throws against death effects.
Undying: they have fast healing 4 and are immune to bleed and disease.
Isekai Immortal Human
(Slime) "Whoa, chimera-like anatomy! Are those scales adapted for subterranean dampness? Fascinating biology!"
{n}Lann scratches his scaled cheek, chuckling.{/n} "'Fascinating biology'? First time anyone's called our cursed mongrel hides a scientific marvel! You're a weird one, surface-dweller."
(Isekai Protagonist) "Scales, horns, hooves and tails... honestly, after falling a mile into the earth and watching a dragon fight, beastfolk scouts don't even faze me. Greetings from the surface."
{n}Lann blinks his reptilian eye in surprise, then grins lopsidedly.{/n} "Well, that's refreshing! Usually surface dwellers scream, pray to Iomedae, or try to stab us. I'm Lann, by the way."
(Slime) "You carry a tremendous concentration of demonic energy. I was looking for a decent meal, and your aura smells surprisingly potent. Yield now, or you are going to become dessert."
{n}Minagho recoils with disgust at your assessing, hungry gaze.{/n} "Dessert?! What manner of repulsive creature are you?! Even the lowest dretches have more dignity than a ravenous mortal!"
(God Emperor) "Your demonic corruption ends here, Minagho. The radiant mandate of my empire shall cleanse Kenabres and cast your filth back to the dark."
{n}Minagho recoils slightly as the aura of divine sovereignty flares around you.{/n} "An empire? Your miserable crusade has no empire left! Only ash and despair await you!"
(Hero) "You can tear down our walls, Minagho, but you can never break our bond! My friends and I will fight until every corner of Kenabres is free!"
{n}Minagho laughs, high and shrill.{/n} "Friendship! Love! How charmingly pathetic! I will make necklaces from the teeth of your 'friends' before this night ends!"
(Mastermind) "Your bluster cannot mask the flaws in your deployment, Minagho. You overextended your vanguard into Kenabres, and your lines are stretched far too thin to hold this garrison."
{n}Minagho sneers coldly, though her demonic eyes dart to her flanks.{/n} "Stretched thin? You arrogant little mortal! The Wardstone is in my grasp, and your pathetic crusade ends right here!"
(Overlord) "A mere regional general of the Abyss? You are an insignificant insect before the absolute sovereign of the Great Tomb. Kneel and prepare to be crushed."

{n}Minagho's seductive sneer freezes, a flicker of genuine bewilderment and rage flashing across her demonic features.{/n} "Sovereign? Tomb? You babble like a concussed peasant, mortal! When I tear your heart out, I will see what kingdom lies inside your ribs!"
(Martial God) "You talk too much for someone whose head hasn't noticed it's already separated from her neck. Let's see if your magic can outpace a thought."
{n}Minagho's lips curl into a vicious snarl.{/n} "Fast words from meat that hasn't met the blade of Deskari! Let us see you outrun your own flayed skin!"
(Shadow Monarch) "Enjoy your fleeting victory, Minagho. When your broken corpse lies at my feet, your soul will rise to serve as a soldier in my eternal shadow army."
{n}Minagho narrows her eyes, sensing the cold abyss of souls slumbering in your shadow.{/n} "You dare speak of enslaving a daughter of the Abyss?! You will die screaming in the dark!"
(Slime) [Admire the Midnight Cuisine] "Nice city you have here! The street food in the Lower City is fascinating. Any chance you'd trade some Midnight Isle recipes with the Tempest Federation?"

{n}Nocticula blinks once, then bursts into a melodious, sultry laugh that echoes through the House of Silken Shadows.{/n} "Culinary recipes?! You tore through the Abyss, fought your way through Alushinyrra, marched into my royal palace... and your first request is Midnight Isle street food recipes?!" {n}She claps her delicate hands, delighted.{/n} "You are utterly charming, little slime. Consider my kitchen archives open to your federation."

(Isekai Protagonist) [Resist Charm with Akashic Encryption] "Drop the mental probes, Lady Nocticula. My soul has otherworldly Akashic encryption and a live audience of Constellations. No puppet here."

{n}Nocticula raises a sculpted eyebrow, leaning back on her velvet cushions with a purr of genuine amusement.{/n} "Akashic encryption... and a live celestial audience? How delightfully exotic. Most mortals who enter my palace fall weeping to their knees begging for a single touch. It seems the rumors of your otherworldly charm were not exaggerated, Commander. Let us speak as equals."
(Mastermind) [Counter-Propose Planar Geopolitics] "Impressive assassins, Lady Nocticula, but a fragile economy. Share Nahyndrian intelligence, and Alushinyrra gains 34% more trade after the war."

{n}Nocticula leans forward, her golden eyes sparkling with sharp appreciation.{/n} "A strategist who speaks in trade margins and economic dominance rather than righteous hymns. You truly are a breath of fresh air, Commander. Let us review your proposal."
(Overlord) [Establish Equal Planar Dominance] "You rule an island of assassins and hedonists, Lady of Shadow. Do not mistake an Overlord for crusader clay, or silk will burn under tier 10 magic."

{n}Nocticula's lips curve into a tantalizing, dangerous smile, unruffled by your chilling threat.{/n} "Such delicious arrogance... and the terrifying magical aura to back it up. A ruler of death who bows to no god. I like you, Overlord. Alushinyrra is honored by your presence. Let us conduct our business with mutual respect."
(Shadow Monarch) [Commune in Absolute Darkness] "You call yourself Our Lady in Shadow, Nocticula. But you rule merely the shadows cast by flesh. I rule the void itself."

{n}The shadows beneath Nocticula's throne ripple in harmonic resonance with your own sovereign aura.{/n} "The primal void... Yes, I can feel it. You do not merely borrow the dark; you are its undisputed master. How refreshing to meet someone who understands the true elegance of shadow. Welcome to my court, Monarch."

A dimensional rift has cracked open reality near Kenabres. Follow the Dimensional Breach on the map beside Defender's Heart, or ask the Otherworldly Emissary to open the way, and confront the entity emerging from the void. Notably, the observing deities talk as if they've seen this play out before.
A Flaw in the Script: Investigate the Kenabres Rift Anomaly

Another transmigrated warrior, Kenji, a masterless swordsman from an eastern realm, has crossed into the Worldwound. The Dimensional Breach beside Kenabres on the Worldwound map leads to him, and the Otherworldly Emissary can open the way from any town. Defeat him to uncover his echo journal detailing previous forgotten crusades.
The Discarded Iteration: Confront Kenji the Exiled Ronin

A shadowy planar horror named Malakor is drawing power from the rift nexus. The Dimensional Breach on the Worldwound map leads to him, and the Otherworldly Emissary can open the way from any town. Destroy him and learn what the rifts have to do with your transmigration.
Behind the Velvet Curtain: The Shadow at the Rift Nexus

Deep in the Abyss, the rift disruption has manifested an immense titan. In the Midnight Isles the Otherworldly Emissary opens the breach from Alushinyrra's cities; back on Golarion, the Dimensional Breach on the Worldwound map leads there. Claim the Key of Causal Rupture, rejecting Yog-Sothoth's whisper to remain comfortably within the endless loop.
The Key of Causal Rupture: Slay the Abyssal Rift Titan

At the precipice of the Threshold, the final guardian of the multiversal barrier awaits. The Dimensional Breach on the Worldwound map leads there, and at the Threshold the Otherworldly Emissary opens it. Defeat the Herald to unlock the core mechanism of the temporal cycle.
Breach the Perimeter: Defeat the Herald of the Closed Threshold

Using the Key of Causal Rupture, confront the Grand Arbiter of the Loop. Only at the Threshold does the last breach reach him: the Otherworldly Emissary opens it there once the loop's requirements are met. Decide whether to remain the adored immortal star of the celestial stream, or shatter the loop forever to claim true unscripted freedom.
Shatter the Infinite Loop: The Unwritten Dawn

{n}Lann glances at Wenduag, then lets out a long breath.{/n} "Well, crazier plans have worked. Not many, mind you. Wait here, I'll fetch the Chief and the others. Somebody has to explain this to him, and it had better be me."
(Isekai Protagonist) [Subjugate the Maze] "I am taking you both. The underground belongs to me now, and anyone who argues will join Hosilla in the dirt."
(Slime) [Assess Gargoyle Caloric Density] "Those gargoyles were surprisingly tough. Not much meat on them, mostly crunchy stone... but their magical essence made a decent post-battle snack."

{n}Regill blinks once, his expression briefly flickering with profound bafflement before returning to stern discipline.{/n} "...Consuming stony fiends for sustenance. Unorthodox. Biologically dubious. But if your digestion removes enemy combatants from the battlefield, I have no tactical objection."
(God Emperor) [Offer Imperial Commission] "Paralictor Regill, your discipline is formidable, but incomplete without an emperor worthy of your service. Swear your legions to my imperial mandate."

{n}Regill's jaw tightens with professional composure.{/n} "The Order of the Godclaw serves no individual sovereign on whim. But if your imperial mandate enforces absolute law and eradicates the abyssal cancer, our hammers will march at your side."

(Mastermind) [Counter-Analyze Regill's Tactics] "Your retreat into the canyon cut flanking angles by 63%, but your triage was poor. Crossbowmen on the eastern ridge would have cost you no Hellknights."

{n}Regill narrows his golden eyes, studying you with razor-sharp analytical respect.{/n} "A rigorous assessment. Most who witness our discipline see only cruelty; you see geometry and resource management. We may find common ground yet, Commander."
(Overlord) [Demonstrate Superior Authority] "Your Order of the Godclaw prides itself on absolute order. But true order does not beg magistrates for legitimacy; it bends reality by supreme will."

{n}Regill stands motionless under your dark gaze, his expression unyielding stone.{/n} "A tyrant's philosophy. Yet the Worldwound is chaos incarnate; against utter disorder, absolute conviction is an acceptable weapon. Prove your supreme will on the march to Drezen."
(Shadow Monarch) [Acknowledge Strategic Elimination] "Sacrificing your wounded to preserve unit cohesion was brutal, but necessary. In the abyss of war, hesitation is the only true sin."

{n}Regill nods once with crisp, measured approval.{/n} "A rare spark of pragmatic clarity. Those who flinch from necessary amputations allow gangrene to consume the whole regiment. Remember that principle when you command the crusade."
(Otherworld Retinue) "Arueshalae, what does our soul bond feel like to you? Can you sense the otherworld energies flowing through our retinue?"

{n}Arueshalae smiles gently, a constellation of soft starlight reflecting in her eyes.{/n} "Standing beside you feels like stepping into a waking dream where the nightmares of the Abyss can no longer touch me. When you share your otherworldly resonance with us, the noise of demonic corruption fades into silence."
(Otherworld Retinue) "Camellia, what do your spirits have to say about the otherworldly power circulating through our retinue?"

{n}Camellia shivers with quiet ecstasy, her delicate fingers caressing the edge of her necklace as she leans intimately close.{/n} "The spirits... they hum with such vibrant, untamed hunger whenever you draw near. The spirits of Golarion are ancient and heavy with sorrow, but your otherworldly essence is fresh, electric, and utterly unconstrained by moral prattle."
(Otherworld Retinue) "Daeran, you seem entirely too comfortable benefiting from otherworldly plot armor. Aren't you worried about the philosophical implications?"

{n}Daeran swirls his goblet with theatrical admiration, flashing a wicked, conspiratorial grin.{/n} "Oh, it is simply magnificent, my dear Commander! Do you know how tiring it is to look over one's shoulder expecting assassins, Inquisitors, or otherworldly entities at every turn? And then you stroll in, radiating narrative immunity like cheap cologne!"
(Otherworld Retinue) "Lann, have you noticed how our retinue bond changes your archery and battlefield survivability?"

{n}Lann scratches behind one of his lizard-scaled ears and chuckles dryly, spinning an arrow between his fingers with impossible speed.{/n} "Look, Commander, mongrels usually have a life expectancy somewhere between a candle in a hurricane and a stray rat at a demonic banquet. Nobody expects us to make thirty, let alone storm a demon fortress."
(Otherworld Retinue) "Regill, how does fighting alongside someone whose soul hails from another reality affect your discipline? Does our retinue bond align with Hellknight doctrine?"

{n}Regill sets down his tactical slate, his cold amber gaze assessing you with clinical precision.{/n} "From a strict standpoint of Chelish martial doctrine, an extradimensional tether that distorts probability borders on logistical heresy. The laws of nature should not bend to accommodate individual commanders. And yet..."
(Otherworld Retinue) "Seelah, how does fighting alongside our retinue compare to serving in a standard paladin order?"

{n}Seelah lets out a hearty, booming laugh, slapping her gauntleted thigh before resting a hand on her sword hilt.{/n} "Honestly? It feels like the best tavern crew in the world, except instead of a round of ale, we share invisible shields and miraculous good luck! I used to think only the Inheritor worked miracles like this."
(Otherworld Retinue) "Wenduag, how do you feel about the instincts and authority channeled through our retinue bond?"

{n}Wenduag flexes her claws, her eyes burning with fierce, hungry devotion.{/n} "In the dark caves beneath Kenabres, power was simple: kill or be eaten. Weaklings prayed to useless statues while monsters tore them apart. But what you possess is something beyond ordinary strength."

(Isekai Protagonist) "Arueshalae... have you ever felt like an intruder in a world you weren't born into? Sometimes I look at the stars and dread waking up back where I came from, with all of this, including us, gone."

{n}Arueshalae looks at you with wide, luminous eyes filled with profound understanding. She gently takes your hand, her fingers trembling slightly.{/n} "Every single day of my life, my love. For centuries I was a creature of the Abyss, a monster woven from sin and agony. Desna touched my soul and tore me from the only existence I ever knew, casting me into a realm of light and guilt where I never felt I belonged. I used to wake up every night terrified that Elysium was an illusion and that I would awaken back in the blood-soaked mud of the Rasping Rifts."

{n}She draws your hand to her chest, where you can feel the steady, warm beat of her heart.{/n} "If you are from beyond the stars, then you and I are both exiles who found each other in the dark. If that distant sky ever calls you back... promise me you won't let go without taking me with you. Because wherever you are, that is the only world I ever want to belong to."

(Isekai Protagonist) "Camellia... you wanted a 'normal' date. What if I told you I'm not even from this world? Where I come from there were no spirits or gods, just cold technology. Does that frighten you?"

{n}Camellia's blush deepens. For a moment she seems to suspect a joke, then she studies your face and finds none.{/n} "Not from this world? You truly have a talent for ruining a perfectly composed apology."
(Isekai Protagonist) "Daeran, be honest with me. Do you ever get the feeling that none of this is real? That we're just actors playing out roles in some grand, absurd cosmic comedy?"

{n}Daeran raises his glass in mock salute, swirling the wine with a razor-thin smirk that doesn't quite conceal the sharpness in his eyes.{/n} "My darling, I have treated life as a hideous stage play since I was a boy. The costumes are itchy, the script is atrocious, and the audience... well, the audience is an insatiable cosmic horror peering through the peepholes in our skulls."

{n}He lowers the glass and looks directly at you, his cynical mask slipping away for a tender second.{/n} "I noticed it the day we met, that faraway glaze in your eyes whenever the crusaders start babbling about prophecy and righteous duty. You look at Golarion the way I look at high society balls: like a bemused tourist trapped in a burning ballroom. But listen to me. If some capricious author is writing this farce, they made one unforgivable blunder. They made me fall in love with the stranger from the gallery. And I intend to enjoy the performance until the curtain falls."

(Isekai Protagonist) "Your Majesty... a century on the throne, carrying a continent's expectations. I did not choose this mythic mantle either. I was torn from my home and thrust into this crusade. Do you ever wish you could set the crown aside and just be yourself?"

{n}Galfrey's breath hitches. For a brief moment, the solemn, unyielding Queen of Mendev vanishes, replaced by an exhausted woman whose heart has carried a century of funeral pyres.{/n} "More times than I can bear to confess to Iomedae, Commander."

{n}She steps closer, her armored hand resting gently over yours.{/n} "When this war is won, Commander... whether your home lies across the ocean or across the stars... let us promise to lay down our armor together, if only for an hour. Just two weary souls who answered the call."

{n}Galfrey glances around the tent before she answers, as if the plain armor could still give her away.{/n} "More times than I can bear to confess to Iomedae, Commander. That is half of why I came here without the crown."

{n}She lowers her voice.{/n} "Everyone sees the Sunburst, the sunlit armor, the divine savior. No one sees the prison it makes. To learn that you, too, were chosen by powers beyond your control... it is heartbreaking, and a strange, quiet comfort. In this camp of thousands, you may be the only one who understands what it means to be an instrument of fate."

{n}For a moment the soldier's disguise slips and the Queen is only a tired woman.{/n} "When this war is won, Commander, wherever your home truly lies, let us lay down our armor together, if only for an hour. Until then, not a word of who I am."

(Isekai Protagonist) "Lann, you joke about your mongrel lifespan... but I have the opposite nightmare. I came here from another world. What if I can't stay, or I'm torn back before we can build a life together?"

{n}Lann chuckles softly, turning a spare arrow over in his fingers. He looks up at you, his half-human, half-lizard expression softening into quiet sincerity.{/n} "Hey... look at me. Thirty years, forty years, an immortal spark from another dimension, who's counting? Down in the caves, our lives were measured in days between demonic incursions. If I've learned anything since stepping onto the surface, it's that time is a joke. It's what you do with the time that matters."

{n}He reaches over and firmly clasps your shoulder.{/n} "If you get ripped back to your world of concrete and glass towers tomorrow, then today was still the greatest adventure of my short mongrel life. And hey, if whatever cosmic force thinks it can take you away without a fight, it clearly hasn't met an archer with twenty-four arrows in flight before it can even blink. You're stuck with me, Chief. Planar barriers be damned."

(Isekai Protagonist) "Sosiel... when you paint, you capture the soul of Golarion. But when I look at the sky, I feel like a ghost wandering someone else's tapestry. Do you ever fear that loving an otherworldly stranger is loving a shadow?"

{n}Sosiel sets down his paintbrush, wiping his pigment-stained hands on his apron. He gazes into your eyes with Shelynite warmth and calm reassurance.{/n} "A shadow does not bleed for Kenabres. A shadow does not stand between ravenous demons and terrified children. A shadow does not look at me with the tender vulnerability you carry right now."

{n}He gently cups your cheek, leaving a faint streak of cobalt pigment against your skin.{/n} "Shelyn teaches us that true beauty is born from harmony, not origin. It does not matter whether your soul was forged in the Inner Sea, the Great Beyond, or a world without magic. The devotion you offer this world, and the love you share with me, is the most authentic masterpiece I have ever witnessed. You are no ghost, my dear. You are the light that brought color back to my canvas."

(Isekai Protagonist) "Ulbrig... you slept a century in stone while everything you loved turned to ash, and I can never go back to the world I came from. Are we both just ghosts in a world that moved on without us?"
(Isekai Protagonist) "After the masks and crowds of the city, this quiet garden feels like home. Where I come from, people chased that feeling under electric lights. With you, I finally found it."

{n}Ulbrig chuckles softly, a grin wrinkling the corners of his eyes.{/n} "No electric lights here, my clever traveler. Just clean air, old trees, and a griffon who finally found his favorite perch."

{n}He pulls you close against his chest, wrapping an arm around your shoulders against the evening chill.{/n} "The old world is gone, and your world across the void is far away. But the garden has accepted you, and so have I. No demons, no dead gods... just the two of us."

{n}Ulbrig tears his gaze from the garden and looks at you, and for once the wonder leaves his voice.{/n} "Ghosts, you say? Aye. For months after I woke, I walked the scarred plains of Sarkoris like a dead man among strangers whose speech tasted like foreign clay."

(Isekai Protagonist) "Wenduag... you worship strength because the underground showed you no mercy. But what if my power isn't mine? What if I'm an ordinary person from another realm, chosen by cosmic spectators who watch us like theater?"

{n}Wenduag freezes, her golden feline eyes narrowing into predatory slits. Her fingers twitch toward her quiver, but slowly uncurl as she steps close enough for you to feel her ragged breath.{/n} "You think that makes you weak, my {mf|master|mistress}? You think knowing the universe is cruel makes you frail?"

{n}A vicious, possessive smile curls across her lips.{/n} "The underground taught me that masters and gods are beasts who only care about what you can take with your claws. If unseen entities threw you into this pit for their amusement, and you turned around and conquered their demons and bent this continent to your will, then you are ten times the predator they could ever imagine! We are both rats who climbed out of our cages to tear out the throats of our keepers. If your gods ever come down from their stars to reclaim you... I will feather them with arrows until the sky bleeds."
(Slime) "Stand back, let me handle this. [Your arm dissolves into a fluid ribbon of green slime, slipping under the boulder and pushing it upward with hydraulic pressure.]"

{n}Seelah stumbles backward, her mouth falling open as your arm snaps back into solid flesh around the edge of the stone.{/n} "By Iomedae's shield... did your arm just melt into green jelly?! What kind of creature are you?! You're not secretly some subterranean demon parasite, are you?!"

{n}Anevia laughs weakly through her pain.{/n} "Seelah, stand down. If a friendly puddle of green ooze wants to lift a ton of limestone off my ankle, I'm not going to complain about its pedigree. Either that's the weirdest spell I've ever seen, or Kenabres just recruited the world's strangest crusader."
(Isekai Protagonist) "Hold on, I'll help with that rock! But tell me I didn't hallucinate it... the kind lady who healed me earlier was a literal SILVER DRAGON?! Dragons actually exist here?!"

{n}Seelah braces against the stone, her eyes brimming with grief.{/n} "Terendelev was our guardian... the shining soul of Kenabres. Seeing Deskari strike her down tore the heart out of every crusader in that square. But we can't let her sacrifice be in vain. Now help me get Anevia out of there!"
(Mastermind) "A silver dragon struck down by a demon lord of the outer rifts. The balance of Kenabres collapsed in under forty seconds. We must extract the injured to preserve tactical viability."
{n}Seelah stares at you in complete disbelief.{/n} "'Tactical viability'?! Anevia's ankle is crushed and Terendelev is dead, you clinical weirdo! Help me lift this damn rock already!"
(Overlord) "Step aside, crusader. Allow true necromantic might to handle this. [You grip the stone. For a split second your disguise flickers, revealing ivory bones and burning red eye sockets.]"

{n}Seelah violently flinches back, her hand flying to the pommel of her holy sword, her eyes wide with terror.{/n} "Your hands... your face! For a second you looked like... an undead skeleton! A walking corpse! What are you?!"

{n}Anevia groans under the shifting stone, waving her hand frantically.{/n} "Seelah, sheath your steel! Look, they're flesh and blood again. An illusion, or some bizarre planar dust from the Worldwound... Either way, the dead usually try to chop off our heads, not heave boulders off our legs. Let's get out of these tunnels alive before we start a religious tribunal."
(Isekai Protagonist) [Absolute Aegis] "...Deploy an otherworldly absolute barrier. No soldier dies today under my command."

{n}Drawing upon power from beyond this realm, you erect an impenetrable crystalline barrier of radiant force across the canyon. The swarming vescavors throw themselves against the light, their mandibles shattering on impact before bursting into harmless cinder. Not a single crusader is lost as the army marches safely past, staring in awe at your godlike protection.{/n}
[Look Upward] "Shut up, all of you! Stop betting coins on my survival like I'm a gladiator in your cosmic circus! I can hear you mocking me from the clouds!"

{n}Seelah glances up at the jagged cavern ceiling, then reaches out to touch your forehead.{/n} "Whoa... hey, easy! You took a nasty blow to the skull when the square collapsed. There's nobody up there but limestone and dripping water. Stay with me, alright? Don't lose your mind now."

{n}Anevia winces, her ankle still pinned under the stone, and offers a dry grimace.{/n} "Voices in the sky betting on us? Honestly, kid, after seeing Deskari strike down a dragon today, gods gambling on our corpses wouldn't even make my top five weirdest crusader stories. Just help Seelah lift this rock."

(Slime) [Summon the Beast Vanguard] "The beasts of the Sarkorian wastes answered my call. 20 Wolf Riders have emerged, eager to tear through fiendish lines."

{n}Feral howls echo across the hills as savage riders surge up to the camp boundaries, their wolves sniffing the air with predatory relish.{/n} "Wolf riders from the Sarkorian wastes! {n}Galfrey nods with deep respect.{/n} "Your military discipline and regal authority have united even the most unruly mercenaries into an iron fist. Lead them well, Commander."
(Hero) [Rally 50 Volunteer Crusaders] "Word of our triumph in Kenabres has spread across the border provinces! 50 Shield Bearers have flocked to our banner to stand with us!"

{n}Queen Galfrey smiles with radiant hope as fresh ranks of resolute crusaders form up, their shields polished and eyes burning with righteous fervor.{/n} "The morale of the crusade hasn't been this high in decades. With stalwarts like these rallying to your standard, I truly believe we can reclaim the Sword of Valor."
(Mastermind) [Deploy Precision Vanguard] "I have calculated the optimal force for breaching Drezen's outer trenchworks. 50 Shield Bearers have been assigned to specific breach coordinates."

{n}Galfrey looks over your operational schematics with genuine admiration.{/n} "The meticulous precision of your campaign plans is breathtaking. Every unit placed with surgical intent. Execute the plan, Commander."
(Overlord) [Summon Deathbound Legion] "Your Majesty, mortal crusaders bleed and break. I have raised 10 Grave Knights from ancient sepulchers. They know no fear and obey without question."

{n}Galfrey raises a hand before you have finished.{/n} "Commander, the muster rolls closed on your name this morning. Every soul you brought me is already counted, armed and drilling in the lower field. I will not enter them twice and draw rations the crusade does not have. Keep whoever else answers your call, and bring them to Drezen's walls instead."

{n}Queen Galfrey stares at you in grim apprehension as cold, armored dread marshals beyond the perimeter.{/n} "Grave Knights... Under any other commander, such blasphemy would see you executed on the spot. But if you can truly bind their dark wills to defend Mendev... I will not turn away steel when the realm is on the brink. Keep them on a tight leash, Commander."
(Shadow Monarch) [Call the Shadowdancers] "An army that leaves no corpses and needs no supply lines. 10 Shadowdancers wait in the camp's twilight, ready for the march on Drezen."

{n}The Queen watches in awe as ten silent figures step out of the shadows of the crusade pavilions, their blades gleaming with cold voidfire.{/n} "Shadowdancers... They move like living mirages. If they can strike behind demon lines without suffering attrition, Drezen's outer bastions will crumble far faster. See them deployed to the vanguard, Commander."
(Slime) [Engulf the Cosmic Resonance] "That obelisk contained so much concentrated essence... and now it's mine. Every demon in Kenabres is just calories waiting to be digested."

{n}A vortex of pure, insatiable hunger spirals out from your open palm, pulling the demonic fog and magic of the room into your chest. Minagho recoils in horror as she feels her very soul being tugged toward the void.{/n} "You... you aren't just resisting corruption... you're eating it?! What kind of monster are you?!"
(Isekai Protagonist) [Channel Unscripted Power] "You thought this was a predictable script? Let's rewrite it right here and now. Feel free to scream, Minagho."

{n}The celestial flames and cosmic starlight swirl violently around your fingertips, shattering the ambient demonic miasma in the garrison hall with blinding brilliance. Minagho stumbles backward, her claws scraping futilely at her chest as raw terror drains the color from her face.{/n} "What... what manner of power is this?! This wasn't supposed to happen! Who are you?!"
(God Emperor) [Unleash Sovereign Radiance] "Mortal, angel, demon, it matters not. Today, the mantle of absolute sovereignty descends upon this garrison. Kneel before your emperor, Minagho!"

{n}Blinding golden light erupts from your chest, towering above the fractured Wardstone in the form of a celestial throne and crown. Minagho shields her eyes with a shriek of agony, the holy radiance searing her fiendish skin.{/n} "A crown?! An emperor?! What is this suffocating light?!"
(Hero) [Ignite the Beacon of Hope] "The people of Kenabres bled for this stone, and their hope will not be snuffed out by demons! Together, we will cleanse every corner of this land!"

{n}A radiant pillar of pure dawnfire engulfs the room, washing away every trace of demon stench. Minagho howls in fury and dread.{/n} "Hope?! That sentimental garbage is burning through my flesh! Stop it! Tear them to pieces!"

(Mastermind) [Synthesize the Harmonic Paradox] "Fascinating. 4,096 causal branches just collapsed into a single deterministic triumph. Your defeat was calculated before we breached the threshold, Minagho."

{n}Geometrical matrices of luminous light hover around your eyes as the residual Wardstone energy synchronizes perfectly with your mental focus. Minagho clutches her head in pain.{/n} "Matrices? Calculations?! You speak as if this whole battle was just an equation! Die, arrogant fool!"
(Overlord) [Proclaim Absolute Dominance] "Did you truly believe you could corrupt an artifact in my presence? You are a pathetic ant crawling across my domain. Die, insect."

{n}A crushing wave of tyrannical necrotic and celestial pressure slams Minagho against the flagstones, and she gasps for breath under your suffocating presence.{/n} "Impossible... a mortal cannot possess such suffocating authority! Who gave you this strength?!"
(Shadow Monarch) [Raise the Abyssal Veil] "The Wardstone was a beacon of light. But true power awakens in the abyss between the stars. Rise, shadows of the fallen, and witness your monarch!"

{n}The bright flash of the Wardstone twists into chilling, pitch-black sovereign shade. The shadows cast by the pillars and fallen crusaders stand upright, kneeling toward you in silent loyalty. Minagho trembles violently.{/n} "The shadows... they are obeying you?! This power has nothing to do with the heavens!"
[Deja Vu: Memory of Past Cycles] "Wait... this square, the banners, your gentle touch... I remember this moment. I have walked this crusade before. Am I trapped in an eternal loop?"

{n}The silver-haired noblewoman pauses, her eyes widening slightly in curious contemplation before she offers a serene, enigmatic smile.{/n} "A sensation of having lived this moment before? Time flows in mysterious currents, stranger. Perhaps your destiny here was written long before today. Stand tall, for whatever cycle you have traversed, your journey in Kenabres begins anew."
(Slime) "Whoa... the burning agony in my stomach is completely gone. That soothing healing aura... you're a remarkably kind doctor, miss. Thank you for patching me up!"

{n}The lady in white smiles gently at your earnest relief, an amused twinkle in her pale eyes.{/n} "A doctor? A flattering title. Rest easy, friend. Your vitality is remarkably resilient, though this wound is no ordinary one."
(Isekai Protagonist) "I'm alive...? I don't know what kind of miraculous field medicine you just used, my lady, but a moment ago I was coughing blood. Thank you. I owe you my life."

{n}The silver-haired noblewoman in white robes smiles with serene warmth, her touch radiating a calming, gentle glow.{/n} "You owe me nothing. In Kenabres, no one is left behind while hope still endures. Save your strength; the festival is just beginning."
(God Emperor) "A magnificent restoration. You possess hands blessed by true celestial grace, noble healer. When my sovereign dominion is established, your benevolence shall not be forgotten."
{n}The lady in white arches an eyebrow with dignified amusement.{/n} "A regal demeanor even with the dust of the road on your tunic! May your high ambitions serve peace and justice, traveler."
(Hero) "Thank you... your gentle hands pulled me back from the brink. When I opened my eyes and saw you standing over me in radiant white robes, I thought an angel had descended from the heavens."

{n}A soft blush touches the lady's fair cheeks as she gives a musical laugh.{/n} "Hardly an angel! Just a guardian watching over this fair city. Take heart, brave soul! The festival needs such bright spirits."
(Mastermind) "Cellular tissue restoration completed in under three seconds with zero scarring... Remarkable medical craft, my lady. My cognitive faculties are fully restored. I am in your debt."

{n}The silver-haired lady blinks in bemusement at your clinical vocabulary, then smiles gracefully.{/n} "Such clinical detachment for someone who just stared into the abyss! Keep that keen mind guarded; clarity is a rare and precious gift in these troubled times."
(Overlord) "To reverse fatal trauma with a mere touch... admirable proficiency, healer. You have preserved a vessel destined for supreme dominion."
{n}She offers a calm, knowing smile, unfazed by your dark demeanor.{/n} "Every life holds supreme destiny in the grand tapestry of fate. Go forth and use this second chance well."
(Martial God) "Lethal chest laceration closed without a single suture... your triage technique is extraordinary, healer. Where I'm from, emergency rooms take hours to pull off miracles like this."
{n}She tilts her head with an amused glimmer in her pale eyes.{/n} "'Emergency rooms'? A curious term from distant lands. But I am pleased divine grace reached your heart in time."
(Shadow Monarch) "The cold grip of death in my chest... lifted. Your restorative power was swift and absolute, my lady. I will remember this debt."

{n}The noblewoman in white robes nods gently, her silver gaze holding ancient depth and compassion.{/n} "Do not speak of debts, traveler. Kenabres stands united under the heavens. Stand tall and celebrate your recovery with our people."

Lesser Plot Armor
For allies who do not practice spellcasting, service in the Retinue sharpens martial instinct. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and a +2 bonus to physical damage rolls.
Retinue Martial Prowess
You stand as the protagonist's unbreakable shield. You gain a +2 shield bonus to AC, a +2 natural armor bonus to AC, and Damage Reduction 5/-.
Bestowed Title: The Aegis
You channel the supernatural energies swirling around the protagonist. You gain a +1 bonus to your caster level and a +2 bonus to Spell Penetration.
Bestowed Title: The Conduit

Upon bonding with the otherworldly protagonist, choose your bestowed mantle: The Aegis (defensive protection and DR), The Vanguard (sneak attack and critical confirmation), The Conduit (caster level and spell penetration), or The Tactician (group competence aura).
Pact of the Retinue
You orchestrate battlefield positioning to complement the protagonist's tactics. You and all allies within 30 feet gain a +2 competence bonus to attack rolls and saving throws.
Retinue Pact Tactician
Allies within 30 feet gain a +2 competence bonus to attack rolls and saving throws.
Bestowed Title: The Tactician
You spearhead the offensive at the protagonist's flank. You gain +2d6 Sneak Attack damage and a +4 bonus on attack rolls to confirm critical hits.
Bestowed Title: The Vanguard

Standing in the presence of the protagonist bolsters your resolve. You gain a +1 morale bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and Armor Class per 3 Otherworld Retinue levels (+1 at 1st, +2 at 4th, +3 at 7th, and +4 at 10th level).
Protagonist Resonance
Desperation awakens deep otherworldly reserves! You gain Fast Healing 10, a +4 morale bonus to attack rolls, and a +4 morale bonus to saving throws.
Shared Limit Break
When pushed to the brink, the soul bond ignites. When reduced below 50% hit points, you gain Fast Healing 10, a +4 morale bonus to attack rolls, and a +4 morale bonus to saving throws for 3 rounds.

At 5th level, an Otherworld Retinue companion cements a profound signature bond tailored to their nature, disciplines, and personality. Choose one signature bond to permanently amplify your combat role.
Retinue Signature Bond

You have ascended to become the recognized right hand of an otherworldly sovereign. You gain permanent True Seeing, a +4 inherent bonus to all ability scores, and your weapon attacks deal an additional 3d6 Holy damage.
The Sovereign's Right Hand

Retinue Discipline Selection
Instinctive synchronization with the protagonist grants you Outflank, Precise Strike, and Allied Spellcaster teamwork feats.
Teamwork Harmony

As a swift action, the Hero rushes to protect a wounded companion. The targeted ally gains damage reduction 100 against physical damage for 1 round, and the Hero enters an awakened state granting a +6 sacred bonus on attack rolls and a +10 sacred bonus on damage rolls for 1 round. Usable 3 + Charisma modifier times per day.
Heroic Miracle: Retribution

At 12th level, the Hero's resolve reaches mythic proportions. 3 + Charisma modifier times per day, as a swift action, you can give a companion damage reduction 100 against physical damage for 1 round while you gain a +6 sacred bonus on attack rolls and a +10 sacred bonus on damage rolls for 1 round.
A rival transmigrated soul from beyond the astral plane: +4 luck bonus to attack and AC and 20% concealment. Defeating it pays 100 Cosmic Coins, once.

Ruler's Authority
You wield the supreme telekinetic dominion of the Monarch, seizing enemies with invisible force to crush and pin them to the ground.

The three golden relics of creation converge fully within your spirit. You achieve complete mastery over courage, power, and wisdom. Grants permanent immunity to death effects, negative levels, and petrification, and an untyped +4 bonus to all physical and mental ability scores.
Sacred Triad (True Hero of Time)

Trigger an emergency soul awakening as a swift action. For 5 rounds, you gain a +6 untyped bonus to all ability scores, +20 feet base speed, an extra attack at full BAB during full attacks, and total immunity to fatigue, exhaustion, and mind-affecting effects.
5 rounds

Secondary Awakening

You possess a secondary awakening reserve that can be tapped during desperate battles.
Benefit: As a swift action, you can activate Secondary Awakening once per day (twice per day at level 15). For 5 rounds, you gain a +6 untyped bonus to all six ability scores, +20 ft movement speed, an extra attack at full BAB, and immunity to fatigue, exhaustion, and mind-affecting effects.

At 7th level, living shadows swirl around the Monarch, deflecting blade strikes and confusing enemy vision. Grants Damage Reduction 10/Silver and a permanent 20% concealment miss chance against physical attacks.

You can drape yourself in the living veil of the shadow domain, dissolving your form into darkness, 3 + Charisma modifier times per day.

You throw a dagger woven from absolute darkness as a ranged touch attack. Deals 1d4 piercing damage plus 1d4 cold damage per 4 caster levels (up to 10d4 at level 40). Targets struck suffer a -2 penalty to AC for 1 round.

You traverse intermediate shadows effortlessly, stepping into the blind spot of enemies as a swift action, 3 + Charisma modifier times per day.

As a swift action, crush and absorb the dark core of a fallen enemy within 30 feet instead of raising them. Grants a +2 profane bonus to attack rolls, weapon damage, and spell DC for 1 minute. Rather than maintaining an endless legion of shadows, you can choose to directly absorb defeated cores to empower your personal strikes, 3 + Charisma modifier times per day.

Shadow Exchange

Continuously maintain your true heteromorphic Skeletal Overlord body. In Skeletal Overlord Form, you gain cold immunity, scaling physical damage resistance, profane defensive enhancements, and undead immunities that unlock at 5th, 10th, 15th and 20th level.
Skeletal Overlord Form (Auto-Maintain)

In your true heteromorphic undead state, you reveal the terrifying majesty of an absolute sovereign of the grave. You possess cold immunity, damage reduction that rises from 5 to 15 (bypassed only by a magic bludgeoning weapon), negative energy affinity, and a +2 profane bonus to your Armor Class and saving throws.
Your undead nature deepens as you grow: immunity to bleed, disease, poison and sleep at 5th level, to paralysis and stun (and immunity to flanking) at 10th, to mind-affecting effects at 15th, and to death effects, critical hits and precision damage at 20th.
Your undead body is not a mortal frame, so your armor, headgear, cloak and clothing are not drawn on it. Nothing is unequipped and everything you wear keeps working in full, with every enchantment on it. A male Overlord becomes a horned reaper that bears its own lantern staff, draws none of your gear and swings that staff whatever you wield; a female Overlord becomes an undead woman who still carries the weapons and shield in her hands.
The form is Medium: a Small character grows to Medium while in it, and takes that size's changes to Armor Class, attack rolls and combat maneuvers.
Skeletal Overlord Form

You were reincarnated into Golarion not as a living mortal, but as an immortal heteromorphic Overlord, a supreme skeletal ruler of death. While you have learned to project a convincing Mortal Guise to walk unhindered among the living, you can unleash your true Skeletal Overlord form at will, gaining cold immunity, profane defenses, terrifying physical resistance, and undead immunities that deepen as you rise in level.

You begin and travel in your mortal guise. Use Shift Form: Overlord / Mortal Guise, a free action, to change shape, or switch on Skeletal Overlord Form (Auto-Maintain) to stay revealed.

Your true form is a reaper of souls: a horned, lantern-bearing reaper for a male Overlord, an undead woman for a female one. It is not a mortal frame, so your armor, headgear, cloak and clothing are not drawn on it: everything stays equipped and every bonus and enchantment still applies. The male reaper draws none of your gear and strikes with its own staff whatever you wield; the female form still carries the weapons and shield in her hands. The form is Medium, so a Small character grows to Medium while revealed.

Step into the coliseum's rift instead.

Analyze the bloom spores and read the residual First World magic.
Leave the glade for now.
{n}You leave the briars behind and step into the starlight of the Planar Coliseum's rift.{/n}

{n}The world twists into a blur of blinding green and autumn gold. The suffocating sulfur of the Worldwound vanishes, replaced by the scent of damp earth, crushed pine needles, and ozone. Standing atop a mossy hillock is a towering figure crowned in stag antlers: the Wild Hunt Monarch.{/n}

{n}You push through dense briars that have erupted from the cracked, abyssal basalt around the Planar Coliseum's rift. Giant phosphorescent flowers exhale luminous fey pollen, painting the grim gray sky in swirling shades of violet and emerald. Littered around the glade lie the carcasses of an entire demonic vanguard, slain not with crusader steel, but pierced by crystalline arrows and shredded by thornwood claws.{/n}

{n}You recognize the telltale signs of a planar bloom. The fabric of reality here is unusually thin, worn through by the coliseum's rift. The First World is not merely invading: it is retaliating against the demonic corruption bleeding through the Worldwound.{/n}

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Much like the Chimera you draw upon the power of inhuman bloodlines and learned how to slowly either awaken or fuse more of them into yourself. 
However, you would rather use that to empower your melee attacks rather than your spells.
After all, what is the point of draconic claws or a phoenixes burning wings if you only use them as a fallback?
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Подобно Химере, вы черпаете силу из нечеловеческих родословных и научились медленно либо пробуждать, либо вливать их в себя. 
Однако вы предпочли использовать это для усиления своих атак в ближнем бою, а не для заклинаний. 
В конце концов, какой смысл в драконьих когтях или пылающих крыльях феникса, если вы используете их только как запасной вариант?
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Ähnlich wie die Chimäre greifst du auf die Kraft von unmenschlichen Blutlinien zurück und hast gelernt, wie du entweder mehr von ihnen langsam erwecken oder sie in dich selbst verschmelzen lassen kannst. Du würdest jedoch lieber deine Nahkampfangriffe damit stärken als deine Zauber. Schließlich, was nützen drakonische Klauen oder die brennenden Flügel eines Phönix, wenn du sie nur als letztes Mittel einsetzt?
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Tout comme la Chimère, vous puisez dans le pouvoir des lignées inhumaines et avez appris comment éveiller ou fusionner lentement plusieurs d'entre elles en vous. Cependant, vous préférez utiliser cela pour renforcer vos attaques en mêlée plutôt que vos sorts. Après tout, à quoi bon avoir des griffes draconiques ou des ailes brûlantes du phénix si vous ne les utilisez que comme dernier recours ?
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 就像奇美拉一样，你依靠非人类血统的力量，并学会了如何慢慢唤醒或融合更多的血统到自己身上。然而，你更愿意用这种力量来增强你的近战攻击而不是你的法术。毕竟，如果你只把龙爪或凤凰的燃烧翅膀当作备选方案，那有什么意义呢？
LocalizedStrings.esES: Al igual que la Quimera, te basas en el poder de las líneas de sangre inhumanas y has aprendido cómo despertar lentamente más de ellas o fusionarlas contigo mismo. Sin embargo, prefieres utilizar esto para potenciar tus ataques cuerpo a cuerpo en lugar de tus hechizos. Después de todo, ¿cuál es el punto de tener garras de dragón o alas ardientes de fénix si solo las usas como último recurso?

LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Что значит щиты не останавливают магию? 
Я могу сделать так, чтобы мой щит тоже блокировал магию. Не вините меня, если вы не достаточно хороши в этом...
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Wie meinst du, Schilde halten Magie nicht auf? Nun, ich kann meinen Schild auch so einstellen, dass er Magie blockiert. Beschuldige mich nicht, wenn du nicht gut genug bist, um es auch zu tun...
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Que voulez-vous dire par les boucliers n'arrêtent pas la magie ? Eh bien, je peux faire en sorte que mon bouclier bloque également la magie, ne me blâmez pas si vous n'êtes pas assez compétent pour le faire également...
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 什么意思，盾牌不能挡住魔法？嗯，我可以让我的盾牌阻挡魔法，如果你太菜导致做不到的话，不要怪我...
LocalizedStrings.esES: ¿Qué quieres decir con que los escudos no detienen la magia? Bueno, yo también puedo hacer que mi escudo bloquee la magia, no me culpes si no eres lo suficientemente bueno para hacerlo también...

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Cavalier Legacy - Magic Shield
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 骑将传承 - 魔力之盾

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Some lead from the front, but while you can charge ahead you prefer to lead from the back.
After all the backline grants you a much better strategic position to evaluate where the problems in the formation are. 
Also, at your core you are a caster, so why should you charge into the thick of things?
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Некоторые идут впереди, но хотя вы можете взять на себя инициативу, вы предпочитаете быть лидером сзади. 
В конце концов, задняя линия дает вам гораздо лучшую стратегическую позицию для оценки того, где находятся проблемы в формировании. 
Кроме того, по своей сути вы заклинатель, так почему же вы должны бросаться в гущу событий?
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Manche führen von vorne, aber obwohl du vorpreschen kannst, ziehst du es vor, von hinten zu führen. Immerhin gibt dir die Hinterreihe eine viel bessere strategische Position, um zu beurteilen, wo die Probleme in der Formation liegen. Außerdem bist du im Kern ein Zauberer, warum also in die dichte Menge stürmen?
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Certains marchent en première ligne, mais bien que vous puissiez charger, vous préférez diriger depuis l'arrière. Après tout, la ligne arrière vous offre une position stratégique bien meilleure pour évaluer où se situent les problèmes dans la formation. De plus, au fond de vous, vous êtes un lanceur de sorts, alors pourquoi foncer dans le tas?
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 有些人带头冲锋，但虽然你也能冲在前面，你更喜欢在后方领导。毕竟，后方的位置能让你简单地评估阵型中存在的问题。此外，从本质上来说你是一个施法者，为什么要冲进人群当中呢？
LocalizedStrings.esES: Algunos lideran desde el frente, pero aunque puedas avanzar, prefieres liderar desde atrás. Después de todo, la línea trasera te brinda una posición estratégica mucho mejor para evaluar dónde están los problemas en la formación. Además, en tu esencia eres un lanzador de hechizos, ¿por qué deberías cargar en medio de la batalla?

LocalizedStrings.enGB: A creature with the fast healing special ability regains hit points at an exceptional rate. Fast healing continues to function even if the creature is unconscious or has less than zero hit points, as long as it's alive. If the creature dies, the effects of fast healing end immediately.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Существо со способностью быстрого восстановления здоровья восстанавливает очки здоровья в исключительно высоком темпе. Быстрое восстановление здоровья продолжает действовать даже если существо без сознания или имеет меньше нуля очков здоровья, пока оно живо. Если существо умирает, эффекты быстрого восстановления здоровья немедленно прекращаются.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Eine Kreatur mit der Sonderfähigkeit der schnellen Heilung regeneriert ihre Trefferpunkte in außergewöhnlichem Tempo. Die schnelle Heilung bleibt auch dann aktiv, wenn die Kreatur bewusstlos ist oder weniger als null Trefferpunkte hat, solange sie noch lebt. Wenn die Kreatur stirbt, enden die Auswirkungen der schnellen Heilung sofort.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Une créature possédant la capacité spéciale de guérison accélérée récupère des points de vie à un taux exceptionnel. La guérison accélérée continue de fonctionner même si la créature est inconsciente ou a moins de zéro points de vie, tant qu'elle est en vie. Si la créature meurt, les effets de la guérison accélérée se terminent immédiatement.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 具有快速恢复特殊能力的生物能够以非凡的速度恢复生命值。即使生物失去意识或生命值少于零，只要它还活着，快速恢复仍会继续发挥作用。如果生物死亡，则快速治疗的效果立即结束。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Una criatura con la habilidad especial de curación rápida regenera puntos de golpe a un ritmo excepcional. La curación rápida continúa funcionando incluso si la criatura está inconsciente o tiene menos de cero puntos de golpe, siempre y cuando esté viva. Si la criatura muere, los efectos de la curación rápida terminan inmediatamente.

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
[Isekai Protagonist Exclusive Partner]
Deathsnatchers dwell amid the ruins of fallen civilizations, where they play at being godlings worshiped by undead slaves. Though self-aggrandizing, deathsnatchers are known to give homage to (and claim descent from) the various demon lords of darkness, the desert, and undeath.
{g|Encyclopedia:Size}Size{/g}: Tiny (Medium at 4th level)
{g|Encyclopedia:Speed}Speed{/g}: 30 ft.
{g|Encyclopedia:Armor_Class}AC{/g}: +4 natural armor (+8 at 4th level, +12 at 12th level)
{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}Attack{/g}: 1 bite ({g|Encyclopedia:Dice}2d6{/g}), 4 claws (1d6), 1 sting (1d4)
{g|Encyclopedia:Ability_Scores}Baby ability scores{/g}: {g|Encyclopedia:Strength}Str{/g} 15, {g|Encyclopedia:Dexterity}Dex{/g} 23, {g|Encyclopedia:Constitution}Con{/g} 16, {g|Encyclopedia:Intelligence}Int{/g} 14, {g|Encyclopedia:Wisdom}Wis{/g} 16, {g|Encyclopedia:Charisma}Cha{/g} 18
At 4th level matures to Medium size (Str 19, Dex 19, Con 18), natural armor increases to +8, and gains Pounce. At 9th level it gains Multiattack.
Note: as a monstrous humanoid the Deathsnatcher has a poor {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Fortitude{/g} save. It is immune to negative energy and to death and channelled-negative-energy effects, but poison, disease and other Fortitude-based effects will land.
At 16th level, the Deathsnatcher gains Finger of Death as a spell-like ability once per day.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: На 16 уровне Игривая Тьма получает Перст Смерти в качестве способности, действующей подобно заклинанию, один раз в день.

LocalizedStrings.frFR: L'attaque de dard du Griffemort devient empoisonnée et inflige 1d4 points de dégâts de Constitution si l'ennemi rate un jet de Vigueur (DC 28).
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 死亡窃取者的刺击变得有毒。如果敌人未能通过DC28的强韧豁免，则会受到1d4点体质伤害。
LocalizedStrings.esES: El ataque de aguijón del Cazamuertes se vuelve venenoso e inflige 1d4 puntos de daño a la Constitución si el enemigo falla una salvación de Fortaleza CD 28.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Deathsnatcher Poison Sting
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 死亡掠夺者毒刺
LocalizedStrings.esES: Aguijón venenoso del Cazador de la Muerte

LocalizedStrings.enGB: The Deathsnatcher is immune to negative energy and deaths effects, and has cold and fire resistance 30. It also has spell resistance equal to 10 + the Deathsnatcher's level.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Игривая Тьма невосприимчива к отрицательной энергии и эффектам смерти, а также обладает сопротивлением к холоду и огню в размере 30. Также у него есть сопротивление магии, равное 10 + уровень Игривой Тьмы.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Der Todesschnapper ist immun gegen negative Energie und Todeffekte und hat Kälte- und Feuerresistenz 30. Außerdem hat er Zauberrüstung gleich 10 + dem Level des Todesschnappers.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Le Griffemort est immunisé contre l'énergie négative et les effets de mort, et possède une résistance au froid et au feu de 30. Il possède également une résistance à la magie égale à 10 + le niveau du Griffemort.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 死亡掠夺者对负能量和死亡效果免疫，具有30点寒冷和火焰抗性。 此外，它的法术抗性等于10 +死亡窃取者的等级。
LocalizedStrings.esES: El Arrebatador de Muertes es inmune a la energía negativa y los efectos de muerte, y tiene una resistencia al frío y al fuego de 30. También tiene una resistencia a los hechizos igual a 10 + el nivel del Arrebatador de Muertes.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Deathsnatcher Resistances
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 死亡掠夺者抗性

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Disease Immunity
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 疾病免疫

You emit an aura of divinity that cause enemies to be overcome with feelings of futility.
Enemies within 40 feet take a -4 penalty on all attributes.
Divine Aura
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 神圣光环

Blessed by the winds of fate in your new life, you can effortlessly dodge even the most well-aimed strikes.
Benefit: You gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC and can move freely without provoking attacks of opportunity.
Special Power - Dodge Master

As a swift action, you can coat your weapon with a special drow poison. The next enemy hit by the poisoned weapon must make a Fortitude save or fall unconscious for 1 minute. The DC is 10 + 1/2 your character level (at most +9) + your Intelligence modifier. Creatures immune to poison are unaffected. Usable a number of times per day equal to your Intelligence modifier.
The next creature hit by this weapon must succeed on a Fortitude save or fall unconscious for 1 minute. This is a poison effect.
Drow Poison
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 卓尔毒药

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You were a nature lover in your previous world, but you lived in a polluted and crowded city that stifled your connection to the natural world. 
You dreamed of escaping to a place where you could be free and wild, and one day you got your wish. 
You have been reincarnated in a world where nature is abundant and diverse, and you have learned how to tap into its primal magic. 
You can cast spells that manipulate the elements, summon creatures, and enhance your own abilities. 
You are a protector of nature and a friend to all living.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
В своем предыдущем мире вы были любителем природы, но жили в загрязненном и перенаселенном городе, который подавлял вашу связь с миром природы. 
Вы мечтали сбежать туда, где вы могли бы быть свободными и одичалыми, и однажды ваша мечта осуществилась. 
Вы переродились в мире, где природа обильна и разнообразна, и научились использовать ее первозданную магию. 
Вы можете произносить заклинания, управляющие стихиями, призывать существ и улучшать свои собственные способности. 
Вы защитник природы и друг всех живых.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du warst in deiner vorherigen Welt ein Naturfreund, aber du hast in einer verschmutzten und überfüllten Stadt gelebt, die deine Verbindung zur natürlichen Welt erstickt hat. Du träumtest davon, an einen Ort zu entkommen, an dem du frei und wild sein könntest, und eines Tages wurde dein Wunsch wahr. Du wurdest in einer Welt wiedergeboren, in der die Natur reichhaltig und vielfältig ist, und du hast gelernt, ihre urtümliche Magie zu nutzen. Du kannst Zauber wirken, die die Elemente manipulieren, Kreaturen beschwören und deine eigenen Fähigkeiten verbessern. Du bist ein Beschützer der Natur und ein Freund aller Lebewesen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous étiez un amoureux de la nature dans votre monde précédent, mais vous avez vécu dans une ville polluée et bondée qui étouffait votre connexion au monde naturel. Vous rêviez de vous échapper dans un endroit où vous pourriez être libre et sauvage, et un jour votre souhait a été exaucé. Vous avez été réincarné dans un monde où la nature est abondante et diversifiée, et vous avez appris à exploiter sa magie primitive. Vous pouvez lancer des sorts qui manipulent les éléments, invoquent des créatures et améliorent vos propres capacités. Vous êtes un protecteur de la nature et un ami de tous les êtres vivants.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
前世的你是一个热爱自然的人，但你住在一个污染和拥挤的城市，这让你与自然的联系变得困难。
你梦想着逃离到一个自由和野性的地方，你的梦想成真了。
你已经在一个自然丰富多彩的世界中重生，并学会了如何利用其原始魔力。
你可以施放操纵元素、召唤生物和增强自己能力的法术。
你是自然的保护者，并且是所有生命的朋友。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Eras un amante de la naturaleza en tu mundo anterior, pero vivías en una ciudad contaminada y abarrotada que sofocaba tu conexión con el mundo natural. Soñabas con escapar a un lugar donde pudieras ser libre y salvaje, y un día tu deseo se hizo realidad. Has renacido en un mundo donde la naturaleza es abundante y diversa, y has aprendido a aprovechar su magia primigenia. Puedes lanzar hechizos que manipulan los elementos, invocar criaturas y mejorar tus propias habilidades. Eres un protector de la naturaleza y amigo de todos los seres vivos.
