LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Любые {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}атаки{/g}, которые вы совершаете, имеют коэффициент увеличения {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}урона{/g}, равный 1 (например, ×2 становится ×3).
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Alle {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}Angriffe{/g}, die du ausführst, haben ihren {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}Schadensmultiplikator{/g} um 1 erhöht (×2 wird beispielsweise zu ×3).
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Toutes les {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attaques{/g} que vous effectuez ont leur multiplicateur de {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}dégâts{/g} augmenté de 1 (×2 devient ×3, par exemple).
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你所发动的任何{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}的{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}倍率增加1（例如，×2变为×3）。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Cualquier {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}ataque{/g} que realices tiene su multiplicador de {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}daño{/g} aumentado en 1 (×2 se convierte en ×3, por ejemplo).

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Omega Strike
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 欧米伽打击

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Seekers of Truth are driven by a desire to uncover the secrets behind the fundamental forces of nature. 
Because of their unique perspective as otherworlders, they are able to approach the world with a fresh and unbiased eye, allowing them to see beyond the surface of things and seek out the deeper truth behind the world around them. 
They are driven by a desire to uncover the secrets of the world that would otherwise remain hidden, and are not satisfied with simply accepting things at face value. 
This allows them to uncover the secrets of the world that are often only revealed to mortals through revelations.

Taken as a second legacy at a higher level, you still receive every revelation you would have had from 1st level.
Oracle Legacy - Seeker of Truth
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Héritage de l'Oracle - Sourcier de Vérité
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 先知传承 - 真理探寻者
LocalizedStrings.esES: Oráculo Legado - Buscador de la Verdad

LocalizedStrings.enGB: At 13th Level, you become immune to fatigue and exhaustion.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: На 13-м уровне вы становитесь невосприимчивы к усталости и обессиливанию.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Ab Stufe 13 bist du immun gegen Erschöpfung und Müdigkeit.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Au niveau 13, vous devenez immunisé contre la fatigue et l'épuisement.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 13级时，你变得免疫疲劳和力竭。
LocalizedStrings.esES: En el nivel 13, te vuelves inmune al cansancio y la fatiga.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Otherworldly Stamina
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 异世界耐力

LocalizedStrings.enGB: After obtaining ungodly amounts of power, some protagonists become Overlords. They view the new world as theirs to play with, and the new inhabitants as theirs to torment. Overlords seek to increase their power even further, often by establishing their own kingdom.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Получив нечеловеческую мощь, некоторые главные герои становятся Владыками. Они смотрят на новый мир как на свою игрушку, а новых обитателей - как на своих мучеников. Владыки стремятся увеличить свою мощь еще больше, зачастую создавая своё собственное королевство.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Nachdem sie unvorstellbare Mengen an Macht erlangt haben, werden manche Protagonisten zu Overlords. Sie betrachten die neue Welt als ihr Spielzeug und die neuen Bewohner als ihre Opfer. Overlords streben danach, ihre Macht noch weiter zu erhöhen, oft indem sie ihr eigenes Königreich gründen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Après avoir acquis un pouvoir démesuré, certains protagonistes deviennent des Suzerains. Ils considèrent le nouveau monde comme leur terrain de jeu, et les nouveaux habitants comme des jouets à tourmenter. Les Régents cherchent à accroître leur pouvoir encore plus, souvent en établissant leur propre royaume.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 在获得了无比的力量后，一些主角成为了霸主。他们认为新世界是他们的游戏，新居民则是他们的折磨对象。霸主们试图进一步增强他们的力量，通常是通过建立自己的王国来实现。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Después de obtener cantidades impías de poder, algunos protagonistas se convierten en Señores Supremos. Ven el nuevo mundo como suyo para jugar con él, y a los nuevos habitantes como suyos para atormentarlos. Los Señores Supremos buscan aumentar aún más su poder, a menudo estableciendo su propio reino.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You have a dark and secret past.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: У вас есть тёмное и секретное прошлое.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du hast eine dunkle und geheime Vergangenheit.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous avez un passé sombre et secret.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你有一个黑暗而秘密的过去。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tienes un pasado oscuro y secreto.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Evil Legacy
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 邪恶传承

LocalizedStrings.enGB: The Overlord is proficient with all simple, martial, and exotic weapons and with all armor (heavy, light, and medium) and shields (including tower shields). They can cast {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spells{/g} from this class while wearing armor and shields (including tower shields) without incurring the normal {g|Encyclopedia:Spell_Fail_Chance}arcane spell failure chance{/g}, but they incur the normal arcane spell failure chance for arcane spells received from other classes. The Overlord also knows the Grave Ray cantrip.
Overlord Proficiences
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 霸主武器熟练

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Overlord
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 霸主

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You use your mythic powers to gain an additional Overpowered Ability.
Source: Isekai Reimagined
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Вы используете свои мифические силы, чтобы получить дополнительную сверхмощную способность.
Source: Isekai Reimagined
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du nutzt deine mythischen Kräfte, um eine zusätzliche übermächtige Fähigkeit zu erlangen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous utilisez vos pouvoirs mythiques pour obtenir une capacité surpuissante supplémentaire.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你利用你的神话力量获得了额外的作弊能力。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Usas tus poderes míticos para obtener una Habilidad Sobrenatural adicional.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Mythic Overpowered Ability
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 神话作弊能力

LocalizedStrings.enGB: As a being from another world, you are granted an Overpowered Ability which no ordinary being in this world possess.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Как существу из другого мира, вам дана Сверхмощная Способность, которой не обладает обычное создание в этом мире.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Als Wesen aus einer anderen Welt wurde Ihnen eine übermächtige Fähigkeit verliehen, die kein gewöhnliches Wesen in dieser Welt besitzt.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: En tant qu'être d'un autre monde, vous avez reçu une capacité surpuissante que nul autre dans ce monde ne possède.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 作为来自另一个世界的存在，你被授予了一种超越这个世界上普通生灵的作弊能力。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Como ser de otro mundo, se le ha concedido una Habilidad Sobrepoderosa que ningún ser ordinario en este mundo posee.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Overpowered Ability
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 作弊能力

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Overlords get to select additional Overpowered Abilities.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Владыки могут выбирать дополнительные Сверхмощные Способности.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Overlords können zusätzliche übermächtige Fähigkeiten auswählen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Les Suzerains ont la possibilité de choisir des capacités surpuissantes supplémentaires.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 霸主可以选择额外的作弊能力。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Los señores tienen la opción de seleccionar habilidades sobrepotenciadas adicionales.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Additional Overpowered Ability
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 额外作弊能力

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You gain an Overpowered Aura that greatly enhances the combat ability of your allies.
Requires character level 15.
Overpowered Aura
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 作弊光环

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You are a true hero, representing all that is good and holy in the world.
Protecting the innocent and smiting the evil.
Less benevolent people might actually throw up a little just from talking to you just because of how inherently good you are.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Ты истинный герой, представляющий все то, что хорошо и свято в мире. Защищающий невинных и поражающий зло. 
Менее добродетельных людй может даже чуть-чуть тошнить, просто от разговора с тобой, из-за твоей несомненной доброты.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du bist ein wahrer Held, der alles repräsentiert, was gut und heilig in der Welt ist. Du schützt die Unschuldigen und bestrafst das Böse. Weniger gütige Menschen könnten sogar beim Reden mit dir aufgrund deiner unbestreitbaren Güte etwas Übelkeit verspüren.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Tu es un véritable héros, représentant tout ce qui est bon et sacré dans le monde, protégeant les innocents et châtiant le mal. Des personnes moins bienveillantes pourraient même se sentir légèrement nauséeuses rien qu'en te parlant à cause de ta bonté innée.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
你是一个真正的英雄，代表着世界上所有美好和神圣的事物。
保护无辜并惩罚邪恶。
那些不那么仁慈的人可能会因为你的内在善良而感到恶心。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Eres un verdadero héroe, representando todo lo que es bueno y sagrado en el mundo. Protegiendo a los inocentes y castigando al mal. Las personas menos benevolentes podrían incluso sentir un poco de náuseas solo de hablar contigo debido a lo inherentemente bueno que eres.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Paladin Legacy - Hero of Light
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Héritage du Paladin - Héros de la Lumière
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 圣武士传承 - 光明英雄
LocalizedStrings.esES: Legado de paladín - Héroe de la luz

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You gain immunity to paralysis.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous gagnez l'immunité contre la paralysie.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你获得了免疫麻痹的能力。

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Paralyzed Immunity
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 麻痹免疫

LocalizedStrings.enGB: At 12th level, you transform the damage you deal into either divine or unholy.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: На 12 уровне вы превращаете урон, наносимый вами, в сакральный или нечестивый.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Ab dem 12. Level verwandelt sich der von Ihnen verursachte Schaden entweder in göttlichen oder unheiligen Schaden.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Au 12ème niveau, vous convertissez les dégâts que vous infligez en dégâts divins ou impies.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 在12级时，你可以将你造成的伤害转化为神圣或邪恶属性。
LocalizedStrings.esES: En el nivel 12, transformas el daño que infliges en daño divino o profano.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Chosen Path
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 选择道路

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Overpowered Ability - Perfect Roll
You gain immunity to petrification.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous gagnez l'immunité à la pétrification.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你获得了免疫石化的能力。

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Petrified Immunity
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 石化免疫

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You were a computer nerd in your last life, you get a +10 Bonus to Knowledge(Programming) and +5 to your MMORPG Skill.
Wait what do you mean there are no computers in this world and all that knowledge and skill is useless?
Well at least some of the theoretical knowledge about magic is applicable in this world: you gain Skill Focus (Knowledge: Arcana).
Player Legacy - Computer Nerd
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 玩家传承 - 电脑宅
LocalizedStrings.esES: Legado del jugador - Friki de la computadora

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You gain a luck bonus to AC and all saving throws equal to half your character level (minimum 1). Furthermore, when reduced below zero hit points, narrative surge triggers, granting damage reduction 20/-, +4 morale bonus to all saves, and immunity to death effects for 3 rounds.
You gain immunity to poison.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous devenez immunisé contre le poison.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你获得了免疫毒素的能力。

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Poison Immunity
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 毒素免疫

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You are Overpowered but overly cautious. You use overwhelming force to ensure all enemies you kill are thoroughly defeated.
Benefit: Your party gains double experience from all sources while below the level the current chapter is built for. At that level the bonus tapers to x1.25, and past it you gain normal experience; Power Leveling never reduces the experience you would have earned without it.
You also project an Overpowered Surge in a 40-foot radius, granting you and your allies a +2 untyped bonus to attack rolls and Fortitude saving throws.
Requires character level 5.
Overpowered Ability - Power Leveling
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 作弊能力 - 快速升级

LocalizedStrings.enGB: At 15th level, you are able to ascend into a higher plane of existence and harness its energies.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: На 15 уровне вы можете восходить на более высокие планы существования и использовать их энергии.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Auf der 15. Stufe bist du in der Lage, in eine höhere Ebene des Daseins aufzusteigen und ihre Energien zu nutzen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Au 15ème niveau, vous êtes capable de vous élever dans un plan supérieur d'existence et d'utiliser ses énergies.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 在15级时，你能够进入更高层次的存在平面并利用其能量。
LocalizedStrings.esES: En el nivel 15, eres capaz de ascender a un plano superior de existencia y aprovechar sus energías.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Transcendental Realm
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 超越领域

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You reflect 25% of the damage you receive back to attackers as direct damage (increases to 50% at level 15). No single hit reflects more than 10 + your character level.
Reflect
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 反射

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Your otherworldly flesh knits itself back together without pause: you regain 10 hit points per round. This healing is relentless, but it cannot hold back death itself.
Regeneration
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 再生

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
The Isekai Protagonist is able to channel both positive energy and negative energy.
So this what happens when you channel one percent of your power...
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Главный Герой Исекая способен проводить как позитивную, так и негативную энергию. 
И вот что происходит, когда вы используете один процент своей силы...
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Der Isekai-Protagonist kann sowohl positive als auch negative Energie kanalisieren. Hier ist, was passiert, wenn du ein Prozent deiner Kraft kanalisierst...
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Le protagoniste Isekai est capable de canaliser à la fois l'énergie positive et négative. Voici ce qui se passe lorsque vous canalisez un pourcent de votre puissance...
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
异世界主角能够引导正能量和负能量。
这就是当你引导1%的能量时会发生的...
LocalizedStrings.esES: El protagonista de Isekai puede canalizar tanto energía positiva como negativa. Así es lo que sucede cuando canalizas el uno por ciento de tu poder...

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Release Energy
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 释放能量

LocalizedStrings.enGB: The damage you deal is now divine damage.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Урон, который вы наносите, теперь является сакральным уроном.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Der Schaden, den du verursachst, ist nun heiliger Schaden.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Les dégâts que vous infligez sont maintenant des dégâts divins.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你所造成的伤害现在是神圣伤害。
LocalizedStrings.esES: El daño que infliges ahora es de naturaleza divina.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Righteous Path
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 正义之路

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Good allies within 40 feet of you have an extra attack and deal an additional 2d6 holy damage.
Overpowered Aura - Righteous Wrath
This character has an extra attack and deals an additional 2d6 holy damage.
Aura of Righteous Wrath
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 正义之怒光环

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Your reincarnation gave you great power; that is no reason to forget the usefulness of a simple backstab.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Ваше перевоплощение дало вам огромную силу; это не повод забывать о полезности простого удара в спину.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Deine Wiedergeburt hat dir große Macht gegeben; das ist jedoch kein Grund, die Nützlichkeit eines einfachen Dolchstoßes zu vergessen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Votre réincarnation vous a donné un grand pouvoir ; cela ne doit pas vous faire oublier l'utilité d'une simple attaque dans le dos.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 转生给了你强大的力量；这并不意味着你忘记了简单的背刺的用处。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tu reencarnación te ha otorgado un gran poder; pero eso no es razón para olvidar la utilidad de una simple puñalada por la espalda.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Rogue Legacy - Supernatural Thief
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 游荡者传承 - 超自然小偷

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Once per day, when your {g|Encyclopedia:HP}HP{/g} drops to 0, you are resurrected to full health. You also gain a +10 profane bonus to all attributes and your size also increases by one size category for 24 hours.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Один раз в день, когда ваше {g|Encyclopedia:HP}здоровье{/g} падает до 0, вы оживаете с полным здоровьем. Вы также получаете нечестивый бонус +10 ко всем характеристикам и ваш размер увеличивается на одну категорию на 24 часа.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Einmal pro Tag, wenn deine {g|Encyclopedia:HP}HP{/g} auf 0 fallen, wirst du auf volle Gesundheit wiederbelebt. Du erhältst auch einen profanen Bonus von +10 auf alle Attribute und deine Größe erhöht sich für 24 Stunden um eine Größenkategorie.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Une fois par jour, lorsque vos {g|Encyclopedia:HP}points de vie{/g} tombent à 0, vous êtes ressuscité en pleine santé. Vous obtenez également un bonus profane de +10 à tous les attributs et votre taille augmente d'une catégorie pour 24 heures.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 每天一次，当你的{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}降至0时，你将被复活到满血状态。并且，你的所有属性获得+10的亵渎加值，你的体型也增加了一级，持续24小时。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Una vez al día, cuando tus {g|Encyclopedia:HP}PV{/g} bajan a 0, te resucitas con toda la salud. También obtienes un bono profano de +10 a todos los atributos y tu tamaño aumenta en una categoría de tamaño durante 24 horas.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You gain a +10 profane bonus to all attributes and your size increases by one size category for 24 hours.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Вы получаете нечестивый бонус +10 ко всем характеристикам и увеличиваете ваш размер на одну категорию на 24 часа.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du erhältst für 24 Stunden einen profanen Bonus von +10 auf alle Attribute und deine Größe erhöht sich um eine Größenkategorie.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous obtenez un bonus profane de +10 à tous les attributs et votre taille augmente d'une catégorie pendant 24 heures.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你的所有属性获得 +10 亵渎加值，并且体型增加一级，持续 24 小时。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Obtienes un bonificación profana de +10 a todos los atributos y tu tamaño aumenta en una categoría de tamaño durante 24 horas.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Second Phase
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 二阶段

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Your attacks ignore damage reduction and your spells ignore spell resistance, spell immunity, energy resistance, and energy immunity.
Once per day, when your {g|Encyclopedia:HP}HP{/g} drops to 0, you are resurrected to full health.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Ваши атаки игнорируют снижение урона, а ваши заклинания - сопротивление магии и иммунитет к заклинаниям. Раз в день, когда ваше {g|Encyclopedia:HP}здоровье{/g} достигает нуля, вы воскрешаетесь с максимум здоровья.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Deine Angriffe ignorieren Schadensreduktion und deine Zauber ignorieren Zauberresistenz und Zaubimmunität. Einmal pro Tag, wenn deine {g|Encyclopedia:HP}HP{/g} auf 0 fallen, wirst du mit voller Gesundheit wiederbelebt.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vos attaques ignorent la réduction de dégâts et vos sorts ignorent la résistance aux sorts et l'immunité aux sorts. Une fois par jour, lorsque vos {g|Encyclopedia:HP}points de vie{/g} tombent à 0, vous êtes ressuscité en pleine santé.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你的攻击无视伤害减免，你的法术无视法术抗性和法术免疫。每天一次，当你的{g|Encyclopedia:HP}生命值{/g}降为0时，你将复活并回复满血。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tus ataques ignoran la reducción de daño y tus hechizos ignoran la resistencia y la inmunidad a los hechizos. Una vez al día, cuando tus {g|Encyclopedia:HP}puntos de vida{/g} lleguen a 0, resucitas con la salud completa.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Second Reincarnation
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 二次转生

LocalizedStrings.enGB: On the verge of defeat, you were somehow able to draw out your secret power...
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: На грани поражения вы каким-то образом смогли высвободить свою тайную силу...
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Kurz vor der Niederlage konntest du auf magische Weise deine geheime Kraft hervorbringen...
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Au bord de la défaite, vous avez réussi à puiser dans votre pouvoir secret...
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 在即将失败的边缘，你不知怎么地发挥出了你的秘密力量...
LocalizedStrings.esES: Al borde de la derrota, de alguna manera lograste sacar tu poder secreto...

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Secret Power
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 隐藏力量

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Consecutive serious punches with limitless force. Any target struck by your attacks is obliterated instantly, dismembering them regardless of their hit points or defenses.
Serious Strike
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 认真打击

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Allies within 40 feet of you transform their damage type into unholy.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Союзники в радиусе 40 футов от вас преобразуют свой тип урона в нечестивый.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Verbündete innerhalb von 40 Fuß um dich herum verwandeln ihren Schadenstyp in unheilig.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Les alliés dans un rayon de 40 pieds convertissent leur type de dégâts en impie.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 40英尺范围内的盟友将其伤害类型转化为污邪。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Los aliados dentro de un radio de 40 pies de ti transforman su tipo de daño en impío.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Shadow Realm
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 影界

LocalizedStrings.enGB: This character transforms their damage type into unholy.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Этот персонаж превращает свой тип урона в нечестивый.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Dieser Charakter wandelt seinen Schadenstyp in unheilig um.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Le personnage convertit son type de dégâts en impie.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 此角色将其伤害类型转变为污邪。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Este personaje transforma su tipo de daño en profano.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You gain immunity to shaken effects.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du erhältst Immunität gegen erschütterte Effekte.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous gagnez l'immunité à l'état secoué.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你获得了免疫战栗效果的能力。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Obtienes inmunidad a los efectos de sacudida.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Shaken Immunity
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 战栗免疫

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
As persons who originated from the other worlds, Spirit Beacons have an unique aura. 
This aura is particularly attractive to spirits, and they have learned to harness the power of these spirits by forming contracts with them. 
Despite their reliance on spirits, Spirit Beacons are not bound by the will of these supernatural beings. 
They are able to maintain their independence and make their own decisions, using the power of the spirits as a tool rather than being controlled by them.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Как существа, происходящие из других миров, Духовные Маяки обладают уникальной аурой. Эта аура особенно привлекательна для духов, и они научились использовать силу этих духов, заключая с ними контракты. Несмотря на свою зависимость от духов, Духовные Маяки не подчиняются воле этих сверхъестественных существ. Они способны сохранять свою независимость и принимать свои собственные решения, используя силу духов как инструмент, а не контролируясь ими.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Als Personen, die aus anderen Welten stammen, haben Geisterleuchtfeuer eine einzigartige Aura. Diese Aura ist besonders attraktiv für Geister, und sie haben gelernt, die Macht dieser Geister zu nutzen, indem sie Verträge mit ihnen schließen. Trotz ihrer Abhängigkeit von Geistern sind Geisterleuchtfeuer nicht an den Willen dieser übernatürlichen Wesen gebunden. Sie können ihre Unabhängigkeit bewahren und ihre eigenen Entscheidungen treffen, indem sie die Kraft der Geister als Werkzeug nutzen, anstatt von ihnen kontrolliert zu werden.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: En tant que personnes issues d'autres mondes, les Phares à Esprits ont une aura unique. Cette aura est particulièrement attrayante pour les esprits, et ils ont appris à exploiter le pouvoir de ces esprits en concluant des contrats avec eux. Malgré leur dépendance vis-à-vis des esprits, les Phares à Esprits ne sont pas liées à la volonté de ces êtres surnaturels. Ils sont capables de maintenir leur indépendance et de prendre leurs propres décisions, en utilisant le pouvoir des esprits comme un outil plutôt qu'en étant contrôlés par eux.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 作为转生者，你的灵魂信标拥有独特的气息。这种气息特别吸引灵魂，并且你学会了通过与它们签订合同来利用这些灵魂的力量。尽管依赖灵魂，但灵魂信标不受这些超自然存在的意志约束。他们能够保持独立并做出自己的决定，利用灵魂的力量作为工具，而不是被它们控制。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Como personas que provienen de otros mundos, las Balizas de Espíritu tienen un aura única. Esta aura es particularmente atractiva para los espíritus, y han aprendido a aprovechar el poder de estos espíritus formando contratos con ellos. A pesarde depender de los espíritus, las Balizas de Espíritu no están sujetas a la voluntad de estas criaturas sobrenaturales. Son capaces de mantener su independencia y tomar sus propias decisiones, utilizando el poder de los espíritus como herramienta en lugar de ser controlados por ellos.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Shaman Legacy - Spirit Beacons
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Héritage du Chaman - Phare à Esprits
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 萨满传承 - 灵魂信标

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
When reincaranting you wanted to be a dragon. 
Because dragons are cool! 
But sadly  that would have been too balancebreaking according to the god of reincarnation. 
Weirdly enough being a shapeshifted baby dragon that learns to reassume his natural form with time is not. 
So one day you will soar through the sky in your draconic form. 
Dragon Claws are useful in the meantime...
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
При перерождении ты хотел стать драконом.
Потому что драконы крутые!
Но, к сожалению, это было бы слишком несбалансировано по мнению бога реинкорнации.
Странно, но ты стал перевертышом детеныша дракона, который со временем научится возвращаться к своей естественной форме.
Так что однажды ты будешь парить в небесах в своей драконьей форме. Когти дракона полезны в любом случае...
LocalizedStrings.deDE:
Als du dich wiedergeboren hast, wolltest du ein Drache sein.
Weil Drachen cool sind!
Aber leider wäre das laut dem Gott der Wiedergeburt zu stark gewesen.
Seltsamerweise ist es aber nicht zu stark, ein Babydrache zu sein, der seine natürliche Form mit der Zeit wieder erlernt.
Also wirst du eines Tages in deiner Drachenform durch die Lüfte segeln. Bis dahin sind Drachenklauen nützlich...
LocalizedStrings.frFR:
Lors de ta réincarnation, tu voulais être un dragon.
Parce que les dragons sont cool !
Mais malheureusement, cela aurait été trop déséquilibré selon le dieu de la réincarnation.
Étrangement, être un bébé dragon métamorphosé qui apprend à retrouver sa forme naturelle avec le temps ne l'est pas.
Donc un jour, tu voleras dans le ciel dans ta forme draconique. Les griffes de dragon sont utiles en attendant...
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
在转世时，你想成为一条龙。
因为龙很酷！
但很遗憾，根据转世之神的说法，这会破坏平衡。
然而，以变形的幼龙身份存在，并随着时间学会重新呈现自然形态，却不会破坏平衡。
所以有一天，你将以龙的形态在天空翱翔。在此期间，龙爪是有用的……
LocalizedStrings.esES:
Cuando te reencarnaras, querías ser un dragón.
¡Porque los dragones son geniales!
Pero lamentablemente, eso habría sido demasiado desequilibrado según el dios de la reencarnación.
Extrañamente, ser un dragón bebé que puede cambiar de forma y aprender a volver a asumir su forma natural con el tiempo no lo es.
Así que un día volarás por el cielo en tu forma draconiana. Las garras de dragón son útiles mientras tanto ...

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Shifter Legacy - Shapeshifted Baby Dragon
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Héritage du Métamorphe - Bébé dragon métamorphosé
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 化形师传承 - 幼龙化形
LocalizedStrings.esES: Legado del cambiaformas: bebé dragón metamorfoseado

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Skinwalkers are rare and dangerous predators that choose to exist above the natural order. 
Rather than communing with nature like the druids, Skinwalkers are known to choose a powerful predator, often times protectors of forests or mountains, before stalking them from the shadows until they find an opportune moment to lay a trap and claim their life. 
They will then ritually skin their prey before donning their hide and using it to transform into a semblance of its once mighty owner. 
Many a novice necromancer has actually looked at you in horror at the realization of just what this ritual skinning involved, because he originally thought he was the evil member of the group. 
The stolen hides carry the corruption of the Worldwound: this legacy follows the Fiendflesh Shifter archetype (Fiendish Aspect, Infernal Claws and Fiendish Resilience in place of the usual shifter aspects, Major Form and Defensive Instinct).
Shifter Legacy - Skinwalker
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 化形师传承 - 剥皮行者

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Why does everyone always think of dragons first?
We griffons are cool too and unlike dragons we are actually reliable servants of the divine and the symbol of nobility. 
So just sit back and watch me save this world after that dragon messed up, as dragons always do...
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Почему все всегда первым делом думают о драконах? Мы грифоны тоже крутые, и в отличие от драконов мы настоящие надежные слуги божеств и символ благородства. Так что сидите и смотрите, как я спасу этот мир после того, как дракон навредил, как всегда...
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Warum denkt jeder immer zuerst an Drachen? Wir Greifen sind auch cool und im Gegensatz zu Drachen sind wir tatsächlich zuverlässige Diener des Göttlichen und das Symbol der Adelsgesellschaft. Lehnt euch zurück und seht zu, wie ich diese Welt rette, nachdem der Drache alles vermasselt hat, wie Drachen es immer tun...
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Pourquoi tout le monde pense-t-il toujours en premier aux dragons ? Nous, griffons, sommes aussi cool et contrairement aux dragons, nous sommes des serviteurs fiables des divins et symbole de la noblesse. Alors asseyez-vous et regardez-moi sauver ce monde après que ce dragon ait tout gâché, comme les dragons le font toujours...
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
为什么每个人总是首先想到龙？我们狮鹫也很酷，不像龙那样，我们是神的可靠仆人和贵族的象征。
所以坐下来看我拯救这个世界，那只龙搞砸了，就像龙总是这样做...
LocalizedStrings.esES: ¿Por qué todo el mundo siempre piensa primero en los dragones? Los grifos también somos geniales y a diferencia de los dragones, somos sirvientes confiables de lo divino y el símbolo de la nobleza. Así que siéntense y vean cómo salvo este mundo después de que ese dragón lo arruinara, como siempre hacen los dragones...

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Shifter Legacy - Shapeshifted Griffon
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 化形师传承 - 狮鹫化形

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Your reincarnation was the action of a god. 
They send you to this world to be a hero, so while you feel a connection to nature this connection is in a way "tainted" by that divine connection. 
Your kin are not the normal animals roaming the woods but the divine beasts of your deities realm.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Ваша реинкарнация была действием бога. Они отправили вас в этот мир, чтобы вы стали героем, поэтому, хотя вы чувствуете связь с природой, эта связь в некотором смысле «искажена» божественным воздействием. Ваши родственники - это не обычные животные, бродящие по лесам, а божественные существа из царства вашего божества.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Deine Reinkarnation war eine Handlung eines Gottes. Sie haben dich in diese Welt geschickt, um ein Held zu sein, daher spürst du eine Verbindung zur Natur, die jedoch durch diese göttliche Verbindung 'verunreinigt' ist. Deine Verwandten sind nicht die normalen Tiere, die in den Wäldern umherstreifen, sondern die göttlichen Bestien aus dem Reich deines Gottes.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Votre réincarnation a été l'action d'un dieu. Ils vous ont envoyé dans ce monde pour être un héros, donc bien que vous ressentiez une connexion avec la nature, cette connexion est en quelque sorte «tachée» par cette connexion divine. Vos proches ne sont pas les animaux normaux errant dans les bois, mais les bêtes divines du royaume de votre divinité.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
你的转生是神的行为。
他们把你送到这个世界成为一个英雄，所以尽管你感觉与自然有联系，但这种联系在某种程度上被那个神圣的联系所“污染”。
你的亲戚不是漫游在树林中的普通动物，而是你神明领域中的神兽。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tu reencarnación fue una acción de un dios. Te enviaron a este mundo para ser un héroe, por lo que aunque sientes una conexión con la naturaleza, esta conexión está de alguna manera 'manchada' por esa conexión divina. Tus parientes no son los animales normales que vagan por los bosques, sino las bestias divinas del reino de tu deidad.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Shifter Legacy - Divine Beast
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 化形师传承 - 圣兽

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Some things cannot be easily forgotten, and in your dreaded former life you were called a hedgehog... 
But this new world shall be respectful to your newfound stingers, as they are even more dangerous than your sharp tongue.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Некоторые вещи невозможно легко забыть, и в вашей страшной прошлой жизни вас называли ёжом... Но этот новый мир будет уважительным к вашим новым жалам, потому что они даже опаснее, чем ваш язык.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Manche Dinge können nicht einfach vergessen werden, und in Ihrem gefürchteten früheren Leben wurden Sie ein Igel genannt... Aber diese neue Welt wird Ihren neu gefundenen Stacheln Respekt zollen, da sie noch gefährlicher sind als Ihre scharfe Zunge.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Certaines choses ne peuvent pas être facilement oubliées, et dans votre misérable vie passée, on vous appelait un hérisson... Mais ce nouveau monde sera respectueux envers vos nouveaux dards, car ils sont encore plus dangereux que votre langue acérée.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
有些事情是不能轻易忘记的，在你可怕的前世中，你被称为刺猬... 
但这个新世界将尊重你新发现的刺，因为它们比你的尖舌还要危险。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Algunas cosas no se pueden olvidar fácilmente, y en tu temido vida anterior te llamaban erizo... Pero este nuevo mundo será respetuoso con tus nuevas púas, ya que son incluso más peligrosas que tu lengua afilada.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Shifter Legacy - Stinger
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 变形者传承 - 刺尾狮

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Your attacks have Shock. They deal an additional 1d6 electricity damage.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Отныне ваши атаки источают электрические разряды. Они наносят дополнительно урон эллектричеством в размере 1d6.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Deine Angriffe haben das Attribut Schock. Sie verursachen zusätzlichen 1W6 Elektrizitätsschaden.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vos attaques deviennent électriques. Elles infligent 1d6 dégâts supplémentaires d'électricité.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你的攻击拥有电击属性。它们会造成额外的1d6点电击伤害。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tus ataques tienen el Atributo Choque. Infligen 1d6 puntos de daño eléctrico adicional.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Shock Weapon
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 电击武器

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You gain immunity to the sickened condition.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du erhältst Immunität gegen den Zustand Übelkeit.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous obtenez l'immunité à la fièvre.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你获得免疫恶心状态的能力。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Obtienes inmunidad a la condición de mareo.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Sickened Immunity
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 恶心免疫

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Your critical threat range is increased by 2.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Ваш диапозон критического удара увеличивается на 2.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Ihr Bedrohungsbereich für kritische Treffer wird um 2 erhöht.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Votre plage de menace critique est augmentée de 2.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你的重击威胁范围增加2。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tu rango de amenaza crítica se aumenta en 2.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Sigma Strike
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 西格玛打击

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You gain a bonus to spell DC and spell hit point damage equal to 1/2 your character level.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Вы получаете бонус к сложности и урону заклинаний, равный половине вашего уровня персонажа.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Sie erhalten einen Bonus auf Zauber SG und Zauberschadenspunkte, der Ihrem halben Charakterlevel entspricht.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous obtenez un bonus au DD et aux points de dégâts de vos sort égal à 1/2 de votre niveau de personnage.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你的法术DC和法术伤害增加，数值等同于你角色等级的1/2。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Obtienes un bonificador al CD y al daño de puntos de hechizos igual a la mitad de tu nivel de personaje.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Signature Ability
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 招牌能力

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You gain a luck bonus to {g|Encyclopedia:BAB}attack{/g} and damage rolls equal to 1/2 your character level.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Вы получаете бонус удачи к броскам {g|Encyclopedia:BAB}атаки{/g} и урону, равный половине вашего уровня персонажа.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du erhältst einen Glücksbonus auf {g|Encyclopedia:BAB}Angriffs-{/g} und Schadenswürfe, der deinem halben Charakterlevel entspricht.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous gagnez un bonus de chance aux jets d'{g|Encyclopedia:BAB}attaque{/g} et de dégâts égal à la moitié de votre niveau de personnage.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你的{g|Encyclopedia:BAB}攻击{/g}和伤害骰获得等于你角色等级一半的幸运加值。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Obtienes un bonificación de suerte a los lanzamientos de {g|Encyclopedia:BAB}ataque{/g} y daño igual a la mitad de tu nivel de personaje.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Signature Attack
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 招牌攻击

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Another Signature Move
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 另一个招牌动作

LocalizedStrings.enGB: At 6th level, you choose a signature move.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: На 6 уровне вы выбираете свой фирменный прием.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Auf Stufe 6 wählst du einen Signature Move.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Au niveau 6, vous choisissez une technique signature.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 在6级时，你可以选择一个招牌动作。
LocalizedStrings.esES: En el nivel 6, eliges un movimiento característico.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Signature Move
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 招牌动作

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You gain an additional 1d6 sneak attack damage equal to 1/2 your Isekai Protagonist class level.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Вы получаете дополнительный бонус 1d6 к урону атакой исподтишка, равный половине вашего уровня класса Главный Герой Исекая.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du erhältst zusätzlichen Schleichangriffsschaden in Höhe von 1d6, der 1/2 deines Isekai-Protagonisten-Klassenlevels entspricht.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous gagnez 1d6 dégâts d'attaque sournoise par tranche de 2 niveaux de classe de Protagoniste Isekai.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 你获得额外的1d6的偷袭伤害，相当于1/2你的异世界主角职业等级。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Obtienes un daño adicional de ataque sigiloso de 1d6 igual a la mitad de tu nivel de clase de Protagonista de Isekai.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Signature Strike
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 招牌打击

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Enemies within 40 feet of you take a penalty on all attributes equal to 1/2 your character level.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Враги в радиусе 40 футов от вас получают штраф ко всем характеристикам, равный половине вашего уровня персонажа.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Feinde innerhalb von 40 Fuß von Ihnen erhalten einen Malus auf alle Attribute, der Ihrem halben Charakterlevel entspricht.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Les ennemis se trouvant dans un rayon de 40 pieds subissent un malus à toutes leurs caractéristiques égal à 1/2 de votre niveau de personnage.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 40英尺范围内的敌人所有属性值下降，数值为你角色等级的1/2。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Los enemigos que se encuentren a 40 pies de distancia de ti sufren una penalización en todos los atributos igual a la mitad de tu nivel de personaje.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Siphoning Aura
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 虹吸光环

LocalizedStrings.enGB: This creature has a penalty on all attributes equal to 1/2 your character level.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Это существо получает штраф ко всем характристикам, равный половине уровней вашего персонажа.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Diese Kreatur erleidet einen Malus auf alle Attribute, der dem 1/2 Ihres Charakterlevels entspricht.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: La créature subit un malus à tous ses attributs égal à 1/2 de votre niveau de personnage.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 这个生物的所有属性值都有一个减值，数值为你角色等级的1/2。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Esta criatura tiene una penalización en todos sus atributos igual a la mitad de tu nivel de personaje.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: As a standard action, grow by one size category and gain a +4 size bonus to Strength, a +2 size bonus to Constitution, and a -2 penalty to Dexterity. You can stay enlarged for 3 rounds per day plus 1 round per character level.
This creature's size is increased by one size category and they gain a +4 size bonus to Strength, a +2 size bonus to Constitution, and a -2 penalty to Dexterity.
Size Alteration
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 体型变化

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Your songs scream out your rage at the world. 
Inspiring your allies to rage along with your songs.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Твои песни кричат о твоей ярости на мир. 
Они вдохновляют твоих союзников присоединиться к твоему буйству.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Deine Lieder schreien deine Wut auf die Welt hinaus. Sie inspirieren deine Verbündeten, sich deinem Wutgesang anzuschließen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Tes chansons hurlent ta rage contre le monde. Elles inspirent tes alliés à se joindre à ta fureur musicale.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
你的歌声嚎叫出你对世界的愤怒。
激发你的盟友跟随你的歌声愤怒。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tus canciones gritan tu rabia al mundo. Inspirando a tus aliados a rabiar junto con tus canciones.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Skald Legacy - Metal Singer
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Héritage du Scalde - Chanteur de métal
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 诗人传承 - 金属歌手
LocalizedStrings.esES: Legado de Skald - Cantante de Metal

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You were a flatterer in your past life, and learned to hone your skills to a ridiculous level. 
No Queen can resist you, and that's a real advantage in these dark times.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Вы были льстецом в прошлой жизни и научились совершенствовать свои навыки до абсурдного уровня. 
Ни одна королева не может вам сопротивляться, и это реальное преимущество в эти мрачные времена.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du warst in deinem früheren Leben ein Schmeichler und hast gelernt, deine Fähigkeiten auf absurde Weise zu verbessern. Keine Königin kann dir widerstehen, und das ist in diesen dunklen Zeiten ein echter Vorteil.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous étiez flatteur dans votre vie passée et avez appris à perfectionner vos compétences à un niveau ridicule. Aucune reine ne peut vous résister, et c'est un réel avantage en ces temps sombres.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
你在前世是一位马屁精，学会了将你的技能推至荒谬的程度。
没有女王能够抵抗你，这在这个黑暗时代是一个真正的优势。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Fuiste un adulador en tu vida pasada, y aprendiste a perfeccionar tus habilidades a un nivel ridículo. Ninguna reina puede resistirte, y eso es una ventaja real en estos tiempos oscuros.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Skald Legacy - Silver Tongue
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 诗人传承 - 银舌

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
You had a hidden passion for karaoke and were devastated seeing that no such thing exist in Golarion. 
As an ever - ready person you decide to train nonetheless since killing demonic armies only with your voice would show your talent to the entire world.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Вы скрывали свою страсть к караоке, и были опечалены, узнав, что в Голарионе такого нет. 
Но вы решили все равно тренироваться, потому что убивать демонические армии только своим голосом покажет ваш талант всему миру.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du hattest eine heimliche Leidenschaft für Karaoke und warst niedergeschlagen, als du feststelltest, dass es so etwas in Golarion nicht gibt. Als immer bereite Person hast du beschlossen, trotzdem zu trainieren, denn Dämonen-Armeen nur mit deiner Stimme zu besiegen, würde dein Talent der ganzen Welt zeigen.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous aviez une passion secrète pour le karaoké et étiez dévasté de constater qu'une telle chose n'existait pas dans Golarion. Étant toujours prêt, vous avez décidé de vous entraîner néanmoins, car tuer des armées démoniaques uniquement avec votre voix montre votre talent au monde entier.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN:
你有一个深藏不露的对卡拉OK的热情，当你发现在葛拉利昂没有这样的事情时感到沮丧。
作为一个随时准备好的人，你决定训练用你的声音杀死恶魔军队，来向全世界展示你的才华。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Tenías una pasión oculta por el karaoke y estabas devastado al ver que algo así no existía en Golarion. Como persona siempre lista, decidiste entrenar de todas maneras, ya que matar ejércitos demoníacos solo con tu voz mostraría tu talento al mundo entero.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: You can add your sneak {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}damage{/g} to any {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} that deals damage, if the targets are {g|Encyclopedia:Flat_Footed}flat-footed{/g}. This additional damage only applies to spells that deal hit point damage, and the additional damage is of the same type as the spell. If the spell allows a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}saving throw{/g} to negate or halve the damage, it also negates or halves the sneak attack damage.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Вы можете прибавить {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}урон{/g} своей {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}атаки{/g} исподтишка к любому {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}заклинанию{/g}, которое наносит урон, если цели {g|Encyclopedia:Flat_Footed}застигнуты в расплох{/g}. Этот дополнительный урон применяется только к заклинаниям, которые наносят урон очкам здоровья, и он является того же типа, что и заклинание. Если заклинание позволяет {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}спасбросок{/g} для отмены или уменьшения урона, то он также отменяет или уменьшает урон от атаки исподтишка.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du kannst deinen Schleichangriff {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}Schaden{/g} zu jedem {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}Zauber{/g} hinzufügen, der Schaden verursacht, wenn das Ziel {g|Encyclopedia:Flat_Footed}überrascht{/g} ist. Dieser zusätzliche Schaden gilt nur für Zauber, die Trefferpunktschaden verursachen, und der zusätzliche Schaden ist vom gleichen Typ wie der Zauber. Wenn der Zauber einen {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Rettungswurf{/g} zulässt, um den Schaden zu negieren oder zu halbieren, negiert oder halbiert er auch den Schleichangriffsschaden.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Vous pouvez ajouter vos dégâts d'attaque sournoise à n'importe quel {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}sort{/g} qui inflige des dégâts, si les cibles sont {g|Encyclopedia:Flat_Footed}prises au dépourvu{/g}. Ces dégâts supplémentaires ne s'appliquent qu'aux sorts qui infligent des dégâts aux points de vie, et les dégâts supplémentaires sont du même type que le sort. Si le sort permet un {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}jet de sauvegarde{/g} pour annuler ou réduire les dégâts, il annule également ou réduit les dégâts de l'attaque sournoise.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 如果目标处于{g|Encyclopedia:Flat_Footed}措手不及{/g}状态，你可以将你的潜行{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}和{g|Encyclopedia:Damage}伤害{/g}添加到任何造成伤害的{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}中。这个额外伤害仅适用于对生命值造成伤害的法术，并且额外伤害与法术的伤害类型相同。如果法术允许{g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}豁免检定{/g}来抵消或减半伤害，则也会抵消或减半偷袭的伤害。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Puedes agregar tu ataque sigiloso {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}ataque{/g} y tu {g|Encyclopedia:Damage}daño{/g} a cualquier {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}hechizo{/g} que cause daño, si los objetivos están {g|Encyclopedia:Flat_Footed}desprevenidos{/g}. Este daño adicional solo se aplica a los hechizos que causan daño a los puntos de golpe, y el daño adicional es del mismo tipo que el hechizo. Si el hechizo permite un {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}tirada de salvación{/g} para negar o reducir el daño, también niega o reduce el daño del ataque sigiloso.

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
Their otherworldly knowledge and point of view allow Chimeras to imbue themselves with different bloodlines in order to gain power and strength. 
Chimeras are constantly seeking out new sources of power, and their ability to absorb and incorporate these different bloodlines allows them to become truly formidable foes. 
However, their constant experimentation with bloodlines can also lead to confusion and uncertainty about their own heritage and identity, as their original ancestry becomes harder to discern over time.

Taken as a second legacy at a higher level, you still receive every Bloodline Evolution you would have had from 1st level.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Once per day, you can dominate any creature for 1 minute per character level unless it succeeds on a {g|Encyclopedia:Saving_Throw}Will save{/g} (DC 10 + 1/2 character level (at most +9) + Charisma modifier). It fights on your side as if it was your ally and will {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} your opponents to the best of its ability. However this creature will try to throw off the domination effect, making a Will save each {g|Encyclopedia:Combat_Round}round{/g}.
Demonic Charm

This {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}spell{/g} summons Areshkagal. Summoned monsters appear where you designate and act according to their {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}check{/g} results. They {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attack{/g} your opponents to the best of their ability.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU: Это {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}заклинание{/g} призывает Аришкагаль. Призванные монстры появляются там, где вы укажете, и действуют в соответствии с результатами своей  {g|Encyclopedia:Check}проверки{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}инициативы{/g}. Они {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}атакуют{/g} ваших противников так хорошо, как могут.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Dieser {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}Zauber{/g} beschwört Areshkagal herbei. Beschörte Monster erscheinen an der Stelle, die Sie bestimmen, und handeln entsprechend ihrer {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}Initiative{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Check}Wurf{/g} Ergebnisse. Sie {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}greifen{/g} Ihre Gegner nach bestem Wissen und Gewissen an.
LocalizedStrings.frFR: Ce {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}sort{/g} invoque Areshkagal. Les monstres invoqués apparaissent où vous les désignez et agissent selon les résultats de leur {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}initiative{/g}. Ils {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}attaquent{/g} vos adversaires au mieux de leurs capacités.
LocalizedStrings.zhCN: 这个{g|Encyclopedia:Spell}法术{/g}召唤出了阿雷什卡高。被召唤的怪物出现在你指定的位置，并根据它们的{g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}先攻值{/g}{g|Encyclopedia:Check}检定{/g}结果行动。它们会尽力{g|Encyclopedia:Attack}攻击{/g}你的对手。
LocalizedStrings.esES: Este {g|Encyclopedia:Spell}hechizo{/g} invoca a Areshkagal. Los monstruos invocados aparecen donde designes y actúan de acuerdo a sus resultados de {g|Encyclopedia:Initiative}iniciativa{/g} y {g|Encyclopedia:Check}comprobación{/g}. {g|Encyclopedia:Attack}Atacan{/g} a tus oponentes con lo mejor de sus habilidades.

LocalizedStrings.enGB:
There is nothing you cannot summon. Your calls are heeded; your commands are absolute. Even demon lords show no negligence... and tremblingly obey.
Benefit: As a full action, you summon a powerful being to bring calamity. You can summon one of the following: Devastator, Playful Darkness, Baphomet, Deskari, Nocticula, Mephistopheles, or Areshkagal. You can have at most one calamity on the field at a time; summoning a new one dismisses the previous one.
Requires character level 20.

You are able to shroud yourself and all nearby allies in a comprehensive protective aegis that scales in power and duration as your character level increases. Disruptive size-altering models and blinding particle storms have been removed to ensure seamless indoor navigation and visual clarity.
• Tier 1 (Level 1+, 1 Hour): Shield, Mage Armor, Shield of Faith, Protection from Evil, False Life, Aid, Barkskin, Delay Poison, Remove Fear, Unbreakable Heart, Divine Favor, Magic Weapon Greater.
• Tier 2 (Level 7+, 2 Hours): Haste, Blur, Mirror Image, Bull's Strength, Cat's Grace, Bear's Endurance, Fox's Cunning, Owl's Wisdom, Eagle's Splendor, Resist Fire/Cold/Acid/Sonic/Electricity, Protection from Arrows, Bestow Grace, Aura of Greater Courage, Displacement, Magic Fang, Align Weapon Good.
• Tier 3 (Level 13+, 8 Hours): Death Ward, Freedom of Movement, Greater False Life, Stoneskin, Spell Resistance, Burst of Glory, True Seeing, Crusader's Edge, Divine Power, Protection from Fire/Cold/Acid/Sonic/Electricity, Magical Vestment (Armor & Shield), Echolocation, Life Bubble, Sense Vitals, Hurricane Bow.
• Tier 4 (Level 17+, 24 Hours): Foresight, Eagle Soul, Shield of Law, Angelic Aspect Greater, Veil of Heaven, Veil of Positive Energy, Mind Blank, Protection from Spells, Heroic Invocation, Greater Heroism.
Combat buffs whose normal duration is measured in rounds - Haste, Blur, Displacement, Mirror Image, Divine Power, Divine Favor, Burst of Glory, Crusader's Edge, Hurricane Bow, Greater Heroism and Heroic Invocation - last 1 minute per caster level instead of the tier duration.
You gain 1 use per day, increasing to 2 uses at level 10 and 3 uses at level 20. Requires character level 5.

LocalizedStrings.enGB: Your mastery over planar realities grants an unquestioned dominion. You gain a +2 bonus to the difficulty class of all your spells and abilities, as well as a +2 bonus to your caster level.
Transcendent Authority

Requires Level 21+. Your martial prowess transcends standard mortal limitations, granting an untyped bonus to all attack rolls equal to a quarter of your character level (+5 at level 21, rising to +10 at level 40).
Epic Superpower - Transcendent Mastery
At 5th level, you can project an aura out to 40 feet. Allies within gain a +4 morale bonus to attack rolls and saving throws, alongside immunity to fear and mind-affecting effects.
Transcendent Domain
Allies in your domain gain a +4 morale bonus to attack rolls and saving throws, alongside immunity to fear and mind-affecting effects.

Upon reaching 30th level, counting your Isekai Protagonist levels together with your levels in any Isekai prestige class, your otherworldly existence transcends the mortal realm entirely. You gain a +4 untyped bonus to all ability scores, a +5 untyped bonus to Armor Class and all saving throws, and 2 additional spell slots per day for every spell level you can cast.
Transcendent Protagonist

The protagonist who has stopped reacting to the story and started ruling it. A Transcendent Sovereign's word becomes law a little more with every level: once a day time stops for everyone else, allies fight inside a domain of the sovereign's authority, and at the summit a single decree rewrites the battle, raising the fallen and unmaking the enemy in the same breath. Seven oaths, one for each Isekai archetype, bend the domain and the crown to that archetype's own story.

Requires 10 levels of Isekai Protagonist and 10 ranks in Persuasion. Every level advances the Isekai spellbook you choose at 1st level. Transcendent Authority (1st): +2 to the DCs of your spells and abilities and +2 caster level. Sovereign Decree (2nd, 4th, 6th and 8th): +1 to attack rolls and Charisma per rank, up to +4. Temporal Inversion - Sovereign Domain (3rd): once a day, freeze every enemy within 60 feet for 2 rounds while you gain an extra attack, True Seeing, speed and +4 dodge AC. Transcendent Domain (5th): a 40-foot aura that gives allies +4 morale to attack rolls and saving throws and immunity to fear and mind-affecting effects. Every isekai hero ends up leading an army sooner or later. The Warmaster is the one who actually read the manual. A general who fights in the front rank, the Warmaster lends the whole line nerve and edge, shrugs off wounds that would drop a company, breaks formations with main strength, and in the end strikes as often as two soldiers put together.

Every level advances the Isekai spellbook you choose at 1st level. Tactical Supremacy (1st): a 30-foot aura you can switch on that gives you and your allies +4 to attack rolls, weapon damage and AC. Battlefield Command (2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th and 9th): +1 to AC and damage rolls per rank, up to +5. Veteran's Grit (3rd): damage reduction 5/- and +4 Constitution. Crushing Formation (5th): +4 to combat maneuver bonus and defense. Unbreakable Line (7th): immunity to fear and 50% fortification. Apex Conqueror (10th): two extra attacks in a full attack, stacking with haste. You also gain an Isekai bonus feat at every even level, an Overpowered Ability at 5th and a Special Power at 9th.
Isekai prestige class for front-line commanders: an aura that raises the whole party's attack, damage and AC, a body that refuses to fall, and two extra attacks at 10th level.

You were once an ordinary person in your original world, until you were summoned by a mysterious entity to another world full of magic and monsters. 
There, you learned how to make pacts with various beings, from spirits and demons to dragons and gods. 
You use your pacts to gain power, knowledge, and allies in this strange new world. 
But beware, for every pact has a price, and some beings may not be so willing to cooperate with you.
LocalizedStrings.ruRU:
Вы когда-то были обычным человеком в своем первоначальном мире, пока не были призваны таинственной сущностью в другой мир, полной магии и монстров. 
Там вы научились заключать договора с различными существами, от духов и демонов до драконов и богов. 
Вы используете свои договора, чтобы получать силу, знания и союзников в этом странном новом мире. 
Но остерегайтесь, потому что за каждый договор приходится платить, и некоторые существа могут не так охотно сотрудничать с вами.
LocalizedStrings.deDE: Du warst einmal eine gewöhnliche Person in deiner ursprünglichen Welt, bis du von einer mysteriösen Entität in eine andere Welt voller Magie und Monster beschworen wurdest. Dort hast du gelernt, Pakt mit verschiedenen Wesen zu schließen, von Geistern und Dämonen bis hin zu Drachen und Göttern. Du nutzt deine Pakte, um Macht, Wissen und Verbündete in dieser seltsamen neuen Welt zu gewinnen. Aber Vorsicht, denn jeder Pakt hat einen Preis, und einige Wesen sind möglicherweise nicht so bereit, mit dir zusammenzuarbeiten.

Mais méfiez-vous, car chaque pacte a un prix, et certains êtres peuvent ne pas être disposés à coopérer avec vous.

[Transmigration Patron] Yog-Sothoth, known across cosmos as the Lurker at the Threshold and the Key and the Gate, is an enigmatic Outer God coterminous with all space, time, and dimensional rifts. When the Worldwound ripped Golarion's planar flesh, it was Yog-Sothoth who pierced the barrier of reality and guided your soul from Earth across the cosmic void into this world. As an Outer God beyond mortal comprehension, Yog-Sothoth is entirely genderless, perceiving all timelines simultaneously and observing your crusade as a single fascinating permutation in the infinite tapestry. (Personal Trial) I formally challenge the Sarkorian sword-saint.
"A formal challenge, entered and accepted. He has been waiting a long time for somebody to do it properly."
(Personal Trial) Call out the Blade Spirit.
"The Blade Spirit does not need calling. It has been watching you fight since you walked in."
(Personal Trial) Convene the bone court on these sands.
"Then the court is convened, and you are not the one being tried. Not exactly."
(Personal Trial) Bring me something corrosive to devour.
"An unusual request, and one this coliseum can meet. Mind the fumes, champion."
(Personal Trial) Put the Primordial Behemoth in the ring.
"The far gate is wide enough. Barely. Step back, champion."
(Personal Trial) Summon the shadows of the fallen vanguard.
"They were crusaders. They will fight you as crusaders. Take what is left of them afterwards, if you can."
(Personal Trial) Set the Throne of Shadows on the sands.
"The throne is already here. It has always been here. Whatever sits on it will want to keep it."
(The Sovereign Divergence) I will be the Benevolent Tempest. What I take, I will keep alive.
"The Tempest, then. The constellations write it down, and they will hold you to it. What you devour, you will answer for."
(The Sovereign Divergence) I will be the Abyssal Void. What I take is gone.
"The Void. The basin does not show me the end of that one, and the constellations have stopped arguing about it. It is written."

Order the citadel's masons, your ordained disciples and every scribe who can hold a chisel to raise the Grand Imperial Dais in the heart of Drezen, and to consecrate it in your own name rather than any god's.

In the life you did not live magic came to you as a flood rather than as a discipline. 
You never learned restraint, only how to survive the surge: a deeper arcane reservoir, a wilder swell of power on every casting, and the scars to prove you have ridden it out before.

In the life you did not live you spent it drawing one sword ten thousand times. 
Spell and stroke are the same motion to you: you strike from a perfect stance, your blade carries the spell, and the first cut is usually the only one you need.

Barren Anomalies: Strays Between Worlds

The same fissures that carried you across the planes drag other things through. Each chapter of the crusade, one more cosmic anomaly settles somewhere it does not belong. The Otherworldly Emissary opens the way to every anomaly in this journal from each chapter's town: Defender's Heart, the crusade's war camp, Drezen, Alushinyrra's cities and the Threshold. On the Kenabres city map and the Worldwound map, Barren Anomaly tiles lead there too.
Each pays its Cosmic Coin bounty the first time it falls. It can be fought again, for a tenth of the experience and no coins.
All five anomalies have fallen. Their fissures stay open, should you want a rematch.
Act 1: The Outer World Stray

A satyr archer has strayed out of the First World into a frozen wood. In Kenabres, the Otherworldly Emissary in Defender's Heart opens the way, and a Barren Anomaly tile waits beside Defender's Heart on the Kenabres city map. Later in the crusade, the emissary in each chapter's town still opens it, and its tile waits beside Kenabres on the Worldwound map.
Act 2: Chronos Exile
An ash giant cast adrift in time walks the ashen hills. The Otherworldly Emissary at the crusade's war camp opens the way, and its Barren Anomaly tile waits beside Kenabres on the Worldwound map.
Act 3: The Transdimensional Behemoth
A glabrezu dragged through a planar fissure haunts the snowbound cliffs. The Otherworldly Emissary in Drezen opens the way, and its Barren Anomaly tile waits beside Drezen on the Worldwound map.
Act 4: Abyssal Void Vavakia

A vavakia warped by the Abyss has found its way to demon-blasted Sarkoris. In Alushinyrra's cities the Otherworldly Emissary opens the way; back on Golarion the emissary in Drezen does too, and its Barren Anomaly tile waits beside Drezen on the Worldwound map.
Act 5: Cosmic Arbiter of Ruin

A balor sent to judge your transmigrated soul waits in an echo of burning Kenabres. The Otherworldly Emissary in Drezen opens the way, and at the Threshold he does too; its Barren Anomaly tile waits beside Drezen on the Worldwound map.

{n}A faint, tight twitch at the corner of his mouth hints at something resembling approval.{/n} "The combat data is irrefutable. Our lines hold against impossible odds and our strikes pierce demonic damage reduction with unsettling regularity. If your otherworld soul provides this tactical superiority, then using it ruthlessly is the only logical course. Continue leading from the vanguard, Commander. I will exploit this anomaly to its fullest strategic advantage."

{n}She lightly touches her bowstring, watching the faint ethereal glow dancing along her fingers.{/n} "Desna showed me that dreams can defy the darkest fate, but your presence makes that truth tangible on the battlefield. When arrows fly and reality shields our hearts, I know that no matter where you originally came from, you brought hope across the stars to save us all."

{n}He leans back, basking in sheer amusement.{/n} "Swords miss by inches, curses fizzle out, and every critical blow somehow feels like a grand spectacle orchestrated for our personal amusement. If the cosmos decided to make you the star of this absurd crusade, having VIP front-row seats in your retinue is the finest luxury I could ever buy. Do keep it up, darling, dying is so dreadfully pedestrian."

{n}She steps close, her breath warm against your ear as she bares sharp fangs in a grin.{/n} "Your retinue bond turns us into apex predators that reality itself fears to touch. When my arrows pierce straight through enemy illusions and shatter demon armor, I feel the heartbeat of your alien world pumping through my veins. You are the alpha whose shadow covers this whole continent, {mf|master|mistress}. And I will hunt down anyone foolish enough to question your reign."

{n}Her expression turns warm and earnestly loyal.{/n} "Back on the streets of Solku, I never had anyone covering my back like this. But when we charge into a swarm of vrocks or balors, I can feel your resolve pulling all of us forward, like an unseen banner that never falters. Whatever realm you came from, Commander, I am glad it sent you here. We're going to win this war, together."

{n}Her eyes glint with a crimson thrill as she whispers.{/n} "When we fight in your retinue, each strike cuts deeper, the blood flows hotter, and that sublime warmth revitalizes my spirit immediately. You call it a protagonist bond, but to me, it is the most refined form of communion. Let us find more demons to bleed, my dear Commander... the spirits demand another feast."

{n}He grins, though his one good eye carries genuine warmth.{/n} "Yet ever since you shared this otherworld retinue mojo with me, arrows fly twice as fast, demon claws miss by a hair, and I feel like I'm breaking every demographic statistic in the caves. If walking in your narrative shadow means surviving long enough to get old and cranky, sign me up for the long haul. Just don't ask me to start giving dramatic hero speeches, all right?"

{n}She smooths her skirts, her eyes darting anywhere but at you.{/n} "Frighten me? No. The spirits have always whispered that there was something strange about you. I simply assumed it was bad manners. If you are a stranger here, perhaps it is no wonder our 'normal' date went so poorly. Neither of us seems to know what normal is supposed to look like."

{n}She draws a steadying breath and meets your gaze, if only for a moment.{/n} "But that is not what I came here to say."

{n}He rests a large, calloused hand on the back of your neck, warm and certain.{/n} "Then I met you. You fought like no warrior of the tribes, spoke of strange cities of iron and glass, and carried a sadness no priest could soothe. The spirits had not abandoned me after all. They sent me a kindred exile from beyond the sky."

{n}A rare, earnest smile softens his weathered features as he looks back at the ancient trees.{/n} "And now they have opened this garden to the two of us. If we are ghosts, then we walk here together."

{n}She looks at you with a mixture of sorrow and profound kinship.{/n} "Everyone sees the radiance of the Sunburst, the sunlit armor, the divine savior. No one sees the prison it creates. To know that you, too, were chosen by powers beyond your control... it is both heartbreaking and a strange, quiet comfort. In this citadel of thousands, you are the only one who understands what it means to be an instrument of fate."

{n}A royal sigil stamped into a silver spear shaft catches your eye: the insignia of a River Kingdoms realm in the Stolen Lands. Before you swirls a vortex of emerald mist, a living Bloom Portal connecting the Worldwound to the First World border.{/n}

"Commander of the Crusade..." his voice rumbles like distant thunder. "The rot of the Abyss encroaches upon our ancient preserves. The rulers of the Stolen Lands spoke of a champion of the Crusade. Show us if your blade matches your legend."

"But not here, where the rot can watch. My court will meet you in the ring the constellations keep: the Stolen Lands Cup of the Planar Coliseum." {n}The mist folds shut, and you stand once more beside the coliseum's rift.{/n}

(Martial God) [Drill the Vanguard in the Way of the Blade] "Your Majesty, I spent the march teaching 50 Shield Bearers to breathe, step and strike as one. None of them will flinch when the demons come."

{n}Galfrey watches a line of shields move in perfect unison, each soldier's stance as steady as a temple bell.{/n} "I have seen paladins train half their lives for that kind of calm. If you can teach it to raw recruits in a few weeks, Drezen's walls will not stand long. Keep drilling them, Commander."

(Isekai Protagonist) [Rally the Survivors of Kenabres] "Your Majesty, the people who crawled out of Kenabres keep asking where to sign up. I have gathered 50 Shield Bearers who want to fight beside us."

{n}Queen Galfrey looks over the new recruits, many of them still wearing the ash of Kenabres on their tabards.{/n} "People follow someone who walks out of the rubble and keeps walking. They will need steel and drilling, but their hearts are already in this fight. See them armed, Commander."
